lemma coe_kummerCocycleRoots (hα : algebraMap K L (a : K) = (α : L) ^ p) (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    (kummerCocycleRoots hα σ : Lˣ) = kummerCocycle α σ

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.coe_kummerCocycles
statement:
lemma coe_kummerCocycles (hα : algebraMap K L (a : K) = (α : L) ^ p) :
    ⇑(kummerCocycles hα) = Additive.ofMul ∘ kummerCocycleRoots hα

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.coe_smul_rootsOfUnity
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_smul_rootsOfUnity {p : ℕ} (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (ζ : rootsOfUnity p L) :
    ((σ • ζ : rootsOfUnity p L) : Lˣ) = σ • (ζ : Lˣ)

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.inv_pow_eq
statement:
theorem inv_pow_eq {a : Kˣ} {α : Lˣ} (hα : algebraMap K L (a : K) = (α : L) ^ p) :
    algebraMap K L ((a⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) = ((α⁻¹ : Lˣ) : L) ^ p

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.kummerClass_eq_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem kummerClass_eq_of_pow_eq {β : Lˣ} (hα : algebraMap K L (a : K) = (α : L) ^ p)
    (hβ : algebraMap K L (a : K) = (β : L) ^ p) :
    kummerClass hα = kummerClass hβ

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.kummerClass_mul
statement:
theorem kummerClass_mul {b : Kˣ} {β : Lˣ} (hα : algebraMap K L (a : K) = (α : L) ^ p)
    (hβ : algebraMap K L (b : K) = (β : L) ^ p) :
    kummerClass (mul_pow_eq hα hβ) = kummerClass hα + kummerClass hβ

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.kummerCocycle_apply
statement:
lemma kummerCocycle_apply (α : Lˣ) (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    kummerCocycle α σ = σ • α / α

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.kummerCocycle_div_kummerCocycle_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem kummerCocycle_div_kummerCocycle_of_pow_eq {p : ℕ} {a : K} {α β : Lˣ}
    (hα : algebraMap K L a = (α : L) ^ p) (hβ : algebraMap K L a = (β : L) ^ p) :
    (α / β) ^ p = 1 ∧
      ∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, kummerCocycle α σ / kummerCocycle β σ = σ • (α / β) / (α / β)

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.kummerCocycle_mul
statement:
theorem kummerCocycle_mul (α β : Lˣ) (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    kummerCocycle (α * β) σ = kummerCocycle α σ * kummerCocycle β σ

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.kummerCocycle_pow_eq_one
groupCohomology.Kummer.kummerHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kummerHom_apply (a : powerSubgroup K L p) :
    kummerHom K L p a = Multiplicative.ofAdd (kummerClass (chosenRoot_spec a))

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.kummerHom_apply_mk
statement:
theorem kummerHom_apply_mk (a : Kˣ) (α : Lˣ) (hα : algebraMap K L (a : K) = (α : L) ^ p) :
    kummerHom K L p ⟨a, α, hα⟩ = Multiplicative.ofAdd (kummerClass hα)

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.mem_powerSubgroup_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_powerSubgroup_iff {a : Kˣ} :
    a ∈ powerSubgroup K L p ↔ ∃ α : Lˣ, algebraMap K L (a : K) = (α : L) ^ p

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.mul_pow_eq
statement:
theorem mul_pow_eq {b : Kˣ} {β : Lˣ} (hα : algebraMap K L (a : K) = (α : L) ^ p)
    (hβ : algebraMap K L (b : K) = (β : L) ^ p) :
    algebraMap K L ((a * b : Kˣ) : K) = ((α * β : Lˣ) : L) ^ p

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.range_powMonoidHom_le_powerSubgroup
statement:
theorem range_powMonoidHom_le_powerSubgroup :
    (powMonoidHom p : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range ≤ powerSubgroup K L p

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.smul_mem_rootsOfUnity
statement:
lemma smul_mem_rootsOfUnity {p : ℕ} (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) {ζ : Lˣ} (hζ : ζ ∈ rootsOfUnity p L) :
    σ • ζ ∈ rootsOfUnity p L

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.smul_units_div
statement: lemma smul_units_div (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x y : Lˣ) : σ • (x / y) = σ • x / σ • y

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.smul_units_eq_self_of_mem_range
statement:
lemma smul_units_eq_self_of_mem_range (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) {α : Lˣ}
    (hα : (α : L) ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L)) : σ • α = α

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.smul_units_pow
statement: lemma smul_units_pow (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : Lˣ) (n : ℕ) : σ • (x ^ n) = (σ • x) ^ n

name: groupCohomology.Kummer.val_smul_units
statement:
@[simp]
lemma val_smul_units (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (α : Lˣ) : ((σ • α : Lˣ) : L) = σ (α : L)

name: groupCohomology.comap_fixingSubgroup_antitone
statement:
theorem comap_fixingSubgroup_antitone {F F' : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)} (h : F ≤ F') :
    F'.fixingSubgroup.comap r ≤ F.fixingSubgroup.comap r

name: groupCohomology.comap_fixingSubgroup_eq_ker
statement:
theorem comap_fixingSubgroup_eq_ker (F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [Normal ℚ F] :
    F.fixingSubgroup.comap r
      = ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := ℚ) (K₁ := AlgebraicClosure ℚ) F).comp r).ker

name: groupCohomology.ker_levelRestrict
statement:
lemma ker_levelRestrict (F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [Normal ℚ F] :
    (levelRestrict r F).ker = F.fixingSubgroup.comap r

name: groupCohomology.levelQuotientEquiv_apply_apply
statement:
lemma levelQuotientEquiv_apply_apply (F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [Normal ℚ F]
    (g : AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (x : F) :
    (levelQuotientEquiv F (QuotientGroup.mk g) x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) = g x

name: groupCohomology.levelQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma levelQuotientEquiv_mk (F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [Normal ℚ F]
    (g : AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ) :
    levelQuotientEquiv F (QuotientGroup.mk g) = AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom F g

name: groupCohomology.levelQuotientHom_injective
statement:
lemma levelQuotientHom_injective (F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [Normal ℚ F] :
    Function.Injective (levelQuotientHom r F)

name: groupCohomology.levelQuotientHom_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma levelQuotientHom_mk (F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [Normal ℚ F] (g : G) :
    levelQuotientHom r F (QuotientGroup.mk g) = levelRestrict r F g

name: groupCohomology.levelRestrict_apply_apply
statement:
lemma levelRestrict_apply_apply (F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [Normal ℚ F] (g : G) (x : F) :
    (levelRestrict r F g x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) = r g x

name: groupCohomology.inflationImage_le_locallyConstantClasses
statement:
lemma inflationImage_le_locallyConstantClasses (M : Rep k G) (S : Subgroup G) [hN : S.Normal]
    [hF : S.FiniteIndex] : inflationImage M S ≤ locallyConstantClasses M

name: groupCohomology.inflation_eq_H1InfRes_f
statement:
lemma inflation_eq_H1InfRes_f (M : Rep k G) (S : Subgroup G) [S.Normal] :
    inflation M S = (H1InfRes M S).f

name: groupCohomology.inflation_mem_inflationImage
statement:
lemma inflation_mem_inflationImage (M : Rep k G) (S : Subgroup G) [S.Normal]
    (y : H1 (M.quotientToInvariants S)) :
    (inflation M S).hom y ∈ inflationImage M S

name: groupCohomology.le_locallyConstantClasses_of_le_inflationImage
groupCohomology.mem_inflationImage_iff
statement:
lemma mem_inflationImage_iff (M : Rep k G) (S : Subgroup G) [S.Normal] (x : H1 M) :
    x ∈ inflationImage M S ↔ ∃ y, (inflation M S).hom y = x

name: groupCohomology.locTotal_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma locTotal_apply (x : H1 M) (v : ι) :
    locTotal loc M x v = (locRes loc M v).hom x

name: groupCohomology.totalPairing_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma totalPairing_apply (x : ∀ v, H1 (Rep.res (loc v) M))
    (y : ∀ v, H1 (Rep.res (loc v) M')) :
    totalPairing loc M M' pairing x y = ∑ v, pairing v (x v) (y v)

name: Rep.relationRepInt_apply
statement:
theorem relationRepInt_apply (B : Rep ℤ G) (g : G) (x : relationCarrier B) :
    relationRepInt B g x = ((relationModule B).ρ g : relationModule B → relationModule B) x

name: Rep.relationSeq_f
statement: theorem relationSeq_f (B : Rep.{u} k G) : (relationSeq B).f = relationModule.ι B

name: Rep.relationSeq_g
statement: theorem relationSeq_g (B : Rep.{u} k G) : (relationSeq B).g = freeCover B

name: Rep.freeCover_freeResMap_apply
statement:
theorem freeCover_freeResMap_apply (B : Rep.{u} k G) (x : Rep.free k G' B) :
    (freeCover B).hom ((freeResMap π B).hom x) = (freeCover (Rep.res π B)).hom x

name: Rep.freeResMap_comp_resFunctor_map_freeCover
statement:
theorem freeResMap_comp_resFunctor_map_freeCover (B : Rep.{u} k G) :
    freeResMap π B ≫ (Rep.resFunctor π).map (freeCover B) = freeCover (Rep.res π B)

name: Rep.relationModule.resMap_hom_apply_coe
statement:
theorem relationModule.resMap_hom_apply_coe (B : Rep.{u} k G) (x : relationModule (Rep.res π B)) :
    ((relationModule.resMap π B).hom x : Rep.free k G B) = (freeResMap π B).hom (x : Rep.free k G' B)

name: Rep.relationModuleInt.resMap_hom_apply
statement:
theorem relationModuleInt.resMap_hom_apply (B : Rep ℤ H) (x : relationModuleInt (Rep.res ϖ B)) :
    (relationModuleInt.resMap ϖ B).hom x =
      (show Rep.res ϖ (relationModuleInt B) from
        (relationModule.resMap ϖ B).hom (show relationModule (Rep.res ϖ B) from x))

name: GroupCohomology.RepImage.map_hom_apply_coe
statement:
theorem map_hom_apply_coe {X' Y' : Rep.{u} k G} (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (α : X ⟶ X') (β : Y ⟶ Y') (w : f ≫ β = α ≫ f') (y : obj f) :
    ((map f f' α β w).hom y : Y') = β.hom (y : Y)

name: GroupCohomology.RepImage.toImage_hom_apply_coe
statement: theorem toImage_hom_apply_coe (x : X) : ((toImage f).hom x : Y) = f.hom x

name: Rep.preHom_comp
statement:
theorem preHom_comp {A A' A'' : Rep.{u} k G} (f : A ⟶ A') (f' : A' ⟶ A'') (E : Rep.{u} k G) :
    preHom f' E ≫ preHom f E = preHom (f ≫ f') E

name: Rep.preHom_hom_apply
statement:
theorem preHom_hom_apply {A A' : Rep.{u} k G} (f : A ⟶ A') (E : Rep.{u} k G) (x : (ihom A').obj E) :
    (preHom f E).hom x = (show A' →ₗ[k] E from x) ∘ₗ f.hom.toLinearMap

name: Rep.coe_toIntRep
statement: lemma coe_toIntRep (M : Rep k G) : (M.toIntRep : Type) = M.V

name: Rep.toIntRep
statement: def toIntRep (M : Rep k G) : Rep ℤ G

name: Rep.toIntRepMap_comp
statement:
lemma toIntRepMap_comp {M N P : Rep k G} (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ P) :
    toIntRepMap (φ ≫ ψ) = toIntRepMap φ ≫ toIntRepMap ψ

name: Rep.toIntRepMap_hom_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma toIntRepMap_hom_apply {M N : Rep k G} (φ : M ⟶ N) (x : M.V) : (toIntRepMap φ).hom x = φ.hom x

name: Rep.toIntRepMap_id
statement: lemma toIntRepMap_id (M : Rep k G) : toIntRepMap (𝟙 M) = 𝟙 M.toIntRep

groupCohomology.greenbergWilesLe_of_greenbergWilesEq

name: groupCohomology.mem_selmerAdm_iff
statement:
lemma mem_selmerAdm_iff (L : ∀ v, Submodule k (H1 (Rep.res (loc v) M)))
    (adm : Submodule k (H1 M)) (x : H1 M) :
    x ∈ selmerAdm loc M L adm ↔ (∀ v, (locRes loc M v).hom x ∈ L v) ∧ x ∈ adm

name: groupCohomology.selmerAdm_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma selmerAdm_bot (L : ∀ v, Submodule k (H1 (Rep.res (loc v) M))) :

name: groupCohomology.selmerAdm_le_adm
statement:
lemma selmerAdm_le_adm (L : ∀ v, Submodule k (H1 (Rep.res (loc v) M)))

name: groupCohomology.selmerAdm_le_selmer
statement:
lemma selmerAdm_le_selmer (L : ∀ v, Submodule k (H1 (Rep.res (loc v) M)))
    (adm : Submodule k (H1 M)) : selmerAdm loc M L adm ≤ selmer loc M L

name: groupCohomology.selmerAdm_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma selmerAdm_top (L : ∀ v, Submodule k (H1 (Rep.res (loc v) M))) :
    selmerAdm loc M L ⊤ = selmer loc M L

name: Representation.adjointAux_mul

lemma adjointAux_mul (u v : Aˣ) :

name: Representation.adjointAux_one
statement:

lemma adjointAux_one : adjointAux k (1 : Aˣ) = LinearMap.id

name: Representation.adjoint_apply
statement:

lemma adjoint_apply (ρ₀ : G →* Aˣ) (g : G) (a : A) :

name: groupCohomology.dualLiftToCocycle_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dualLiftToCocycle_coe {ρ₀ : G →* Aˣ} {ρ : G →* (A[ε])ˣ} (hρ : IsDualLift ρ₀ ρ) :

name: Representation.TateResCor.coe_cosetNormInvariants_apply

name: Representation.TateResCor.coinvariantsCores_mk

    coinvariantsCores ρ S (Coinvariants.mk (ρ.comp S.subtype) v) = Coinvariants.mk ρ v

name: Representation.TateResCor.coinvariantsTransfer_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma coinvariantsTransfer_mk (v : V) :
    coinvariantsTransfer ρ S (Coinvariants.mk ρ v) = Coinvariants.mk (ρ.comp S.subtype) (cosetTransfer ρ S v)

name: Representation.TateResCor.cosetDecomp_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma cosetDecomp_apply (p : (G ⧸ S) × S) : cosetDecomp S p = p.1.out * p.2

name: Representation.TateResCor.cosetNorm_apply
statement: lemma cosetNorm_apply [Fintype (G ⧸ S)] (v : V) : cosetNorm ρ S v = ∑ q : G ⧸ S, ρ q.out v

name: Representation.TateResCor.cosetNorm_eq_sum
statement: lemma cosetNorm_eq_sum [Fintype (G ⧸ S)] : cosetNorm ρ S = ∑ q : G ⧸ S, ρ q.out

name: Representation.TateResCor.cosetTransfer_apply
statement: lemma cosetTransfer_apply [Fintype (G ⧸ S)] (v : V) : cosetTransfer ρ S v = ∑ q : G ⧸ S, ρ q.out⁻¹ v

name: Representation.TateResCor.cosetTransfer_eq_sum
statement: lemma cosetTransfer_eq_sum [Fintype (G ⧸ S)] : cosetTransfer ρ S = ∑ q : G ⧸ S, ρ q.out⁻¹

name: Representation.TateResCor.exists_out_smul_eq
statement: lemma exists_out_smul_eq (g : G) (q : G ⧸ S) : ∃ s : S, (g • q).out = g * q.out * s

name: Representation.TateResCor.invariants_le_invariants_res
statement: lemma invariants_le_invariants_res : ρ.invariants ≤ Representation.invariants (ρ.comp S.subtype)

name: Representation.TateResCor.mk_cosetTransfer_self_apply

lemma mk_cosetTransfer_self_apply [Fintype G] (g : G) (v : V) :
    Coinvariants.mk (ρ.comp S.subtype) (cosetTransfer ρ S (ρ g v)) =
      Coinvariants.mk (ρ.comp S.subtype) (cosetTransfer ρ S v)

name: Representation.TateResCor.mk_self_apply
statement: lemma mk_self_apply (g : G) (v : V) : Coinvariants.mk ρ (ρ g v) = Coinvariants.mk ρ v

name: Representation.TateResCor.mk_surjective
statement: lemma mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (Coinvariants.mk ρ)

name: Representation.TateResCor.norm_eq_cosetNorm_norm_res
statement:
lemma norm_eq_cosetNorm_norm_res [Fintype G] [Fintype S] (v : V) :
    ρ.norm v = cosetNorm ρ S (Representation.norm (ρ.comp S.subtype) v)

name: Representation.TateResCor.norm_eq_norm_res_cosetTransfer
statement:
lemma norm_eq_norm_res_cosetTransfer [Fintype G] [Fintype S] (v : V) :
    ρ.norm v = Representation.norm (ρ.comp S.subtype) (cosetTransfer ρ S v)

name: Representation.TateResCor.norm_res_subtype_apply
statement: lemma norm_res_subtype_apply [Fintype S] (v : V) : Representation.norm (ρ.comp S.subtype) v = ∑ s : S, ρ s v

name: Representation.TateResCor.range_normBar_le_comap_inclusion
statement:
lemma range_normBar_le_comap_inclusion :
    LinearMap.range ρ.normBar ≤
      (LinearMap.range (Representation.normBar (ρ.comp S.subtype))).comap (Submodule.inclusion (invariants_le_invariants_res ρ S))

name: Representation.TateResCor.range_normBar_res_le_comap_cosetNormInvariants
statement:
lemma range_normBar_res_le_comap_cosetNormInvariants :
    LinearMap.range (Representation.normBar (ρ.comp S.subtype)) ≤ (LinearMap.range ρ.normBar).comap (cosetNormInvariants ρ S)

name: Representation.TateResCor.self_cosetNorm_apply
statement:
lemma self_cosetNorm_apply [Fintype G] (g : G) (v : V) (hv : ∀ s : S, ρ s v = v) :
    ρ g (cosetNorm ρ S v) = cosetNorm ρ S v

name: Representation.TateResCor.sum_eq_sum_sum
statement:
lemma sum_eq_sum_sum {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Fintype G] [Fintype S] [Fintype (G ⧸ S)] (f : G → M) :
    ∑ g : G, f g = ∑ q : G ⧸ S, ∑ s : S, f (q.out * s)

name: groupCohomology.evalAtGen_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma evalAtGen_apply (t : G) (f : cocycles₁ A) :
    evalAtGen A t f = Submodule.Quotient.mk (f t)

name: groupCohomology.frobeniusOnCoinvariants_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma frobeniusOnCoinvariants_mk [Finite G] (t φ : G)
    (h : φ * t * φ⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers t) (x : A) :
    frobeniusOnCoinvariants A t φ h (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =

name: HeckeCohomology.cls_rep_mul
statement: theorem cls_rep_mul (x δ : Γ) : cls S₂ (rep S₂ (cls S₂ x) * δ) = cls S₂ (x * δ)

name: HeckeCohomology.coe_heckeInv
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_heckeInv (φ : A →ₗ[k] A) (hφ : IsTwist S₁ S₂ c A φ) (z : A.ρ.invariants) :
    ((heckeInv S₁ S₂ c A φ hφ z : A.ρ.invariants) : A) = norm0 S₂ A φ z

name: HeckeCohomology.corFun_add
statement: theorem corFun_add (g g' : S₂ → A) : corFun S₂ A (g + g') = corFun S₂ A g + corFun S₂ A g'

name: HeckeCohomology.corFun_coboundary
statement:
theorem corFun_coboundary (a : A) :
    corFun S₂ A (fun s => A.ρ (s : Γ) a - a) =
      fun γ => A.ρ γ (∑ q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel S₂), A.ρ (rep S₂ q)⁻¹ a) -
        ∑ q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel S₂), A.ρ (rep S₂ q)⁻¹ a

name: HeckeCohomology.corFun_smul
statement: theorem corFun_smul (r : k) (g : S₂ → A) : corFun S₂ A (r • g) = r • corFun S₂ A g

name: HeckeCohomology.heckeH1_unique
statement:
theorem heckeH1_unique (φ : A →ₗ[k] A) (hφ : IsTwist S₁ S₂ c A φ) (T : H1 A → H1 A)
    (hT : ∀ f : cocycles₁ A, T (H1π A f) = H1π A (heckeZ1 S₁ S₂ c A φ hφ f)) :
    T = heckeH1 S₁ S₂ c A φ hφ

name: HeckeCohomology.heckeZ1Lin_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem heckeZ1Lin_apply (φ : A →ₗ[k] A) (hφ : IsTwist S₁ S₂ c A φ) (f : cocycles₁ A) :
    heckeZ1Lin S₁ S₂ c A φ hφ f = heckeZ1 S₁ S₂ c A φ hφ f

name: HeckeCohomology.heckeZ1_apply
statement:
theorem heckeZ1_apply (φ : A →ₗ[k] A) (hφ : IsTwist S₁ S₂ c A φ) (f : cocycles₁ A) (γ : Γ) :
    heckeZ1 S₁ S₂ c A φ hφ f γ =
      ∑ q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel S₂), A.ρ (rep S₂ q)⁻¹ (φ (f (c (slip S₂ q γ) : Γ)))

name: HeckeCohomology.heckeZ1_descends
statement:
theorem heckeZ1_descends (φ : A →ₗ[k] A) (hφ : IsTwist S₁ S₂ c A φ) (f f' : cocycles₁ A)
    (h : H1π A f = H1π A f') : H1π A (heckeZ1 S₁ S₂ c A φ hφ f) = H1π A (heckeZ1 S₁ S₂ c A φ hφ f')

name: HeckeCohomology.mulRight_apply
statement:
theorem mulRight_apply (γ : Γ) (q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel S₂)) :
    mulRight S₂ γ q = cls S₂ (rep S₂ q * γ)

name: HeckeCohomology.norm0_apply
statement:
theorem norm0_apply (φ : A →ₗ[k] A) (a : A) :
    norm0 S₂ A φ a = ∑ q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel S₂), A.ρ (rep S₂ q)⁻¹ (φ a)

name: HeckeCohomology.norm0_mem_invariants
statement:
theorem norm0_mem_invariants (φ : A →ₗ[k] A) (hφ : IsTwist S₁ S₂ c A φ) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ A.ρ.invariants) : norm0 S₂ A φ a ∈ A.ρ.invariants

name: HeckeCohomology.slip_mul
statement:
theorem slip_mul (q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel S₂)) (γ δ : Γ) :
    slip S₂ q (γ * δ) = slip S₂ q γ * slip S₂ (cls S₂ (rep S₂ q * γ)) δ

name: HeckeCohomology.transport_cocycle
statement:
theorem transport_cocycle (φ : A →ₗ[k] A) (hφ : IsTwist S₁ S₂ c A φ) (f : cocycles₁ A) :
    ∀ s t : S₂, φ (f (c (s * t) : Γ)) = A.ρ (s : Γ) (φ (f (c t : Γ))) + φ (f (c s : Γ))

name: HahnSeries.coeff_hahnTwist
statement:

theorem coeff_hahnTwist (χ : Multiplicative ℚ →* Rˣ) (x : HahnSeries ℚ R) (a : ℚ) :

name: HahnSeries.coeff_hahnTwistFun

name: HahnSeries.fixes_single_one_of_mem_monodromy

theorem hahnTwistFun_single (χ : Multiplicative ℚ →* Rˣ) (a : ℚ) (r : R) :

name: HahnSeries.hahnTwistHom_apply
statement:
theorem hahnTwistHom_apply (χ : Multiplicative ℚ →* Rˣ) :

name: HahnSeries.hahnTwist_single
statement:
theorem hahnTwist_single (χ : Multiplicative ℚ →* Rˣ) (a : ℚ) (r : R) :

name: HahnSeries.mem_monoChar_iff
statement:
theorem mem_monoChar_iff {χ : Multiplicative ℚ →* Rˣ} :
    χ ∈ MonoChar R ↔ χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℚ)) = 1

name: HahnSeries.order_hahnTwist
statement:
theorem order_hahnTwist (χ : Multiplicative ℚ →* Rˣ) (x : HahnSeries ℚ R) :
    (hahnTwist χ x).order = x.order

name: HahnSeries.support_hahnTwist
statement:
theorem support_hahnTwist (χ : Multiplicative ℚ →* Rˣ) (x : HahnSeries ℚ R) :

name: HahnSeries.support_hahnTwistFun
statement:
theorem support_hahnTwistFun (χ : Multiplicative ℚ →* Rˣ) (x : HahnSeries ℚ R) :

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.fixedTransport_some
statement:
theorem fixedTransport_some [DecidableEq K] (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (E : WeierstrassCurve K)

    fixedTransport σ E hE (some x y h) = some (σ x) (σ y) (nonsingular_of_fixed σ E hE h)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.fixedTransport_zero

theorem fixedTransport_zero [DecidableEq K] (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (E : WeierstrassCurve K)

name: HeckeEis.bezout_of_prime_not_dvd

name: HeckeEis.coe_iotaUpperEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem coe_iotaUpperEquiv_symm (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (δ : ↥(heckeUpper N q)) :
    (((((iotaUpperEquiv N q).symm δ) : Gamma0 (N * q)) : SL(2, ℤ)) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)
      = !![((((δ : Gamma0 N) : SL(2, ℤ)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)) 0 0,
            ((((δ : Gamma0 N) : SL(2, ℤ)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)) 0 1 / (q : ℤ);
          ((((δ : Gamma0 N) : SL(2, ℤ)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)) 1 0 * (q : ℤ),
            ((((δ : Gamma0 N) : SL(2, ℤ)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)) 1 1]

name: HeckeEis.coe_iotaUpperHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_iotaUpperHom (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (γ : Gamma0 (N * q)) :
    (iotaUpperHom N q γ : Gamma0 N) = Ihara.ι₁ N q γ

name: HeckeEis.heckeConj_iotaUpperHom
statement:
theorem heckeConj_iotaUpperHom (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (γ : Gamma0 (N * q)) :
    heckeConj N q (iotaUpperHom N q γ) = Ihara.ι₀ N q γ

name: HeckeEis.iota1_alConjHom
statement:
theorem iota1_alConjHom (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (u : Gamma0 N)
    (hu : ∀ γ : Gamma0 (N * q),
      (q : ℤ) ∣ ((u * Ihara.ι₀ N q γ * u⁻¹ : Gamma0 N) : SL(2, ℤ)) 0 1)
    (γ : Gamma0 (N * q)) :
    Ihara.ι₁ N q (alConjHom N q u hu γ) = u * Ihara.ι₀ N q γ * u⁻¹

name: HeckeEis.iotaUpperEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem iotaUpperEquiv_apply (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (γ : Gamma0 (N * q)) :
    iotaUpperEquiv N q γ = iotaUpperHom N q γ

name: HeckeEis.range_iota1
statement:
theorem range_iota1 (N : ℕ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (Ihara.ι₁ N q).range = heckeUpper N q

name: HeckeEis.IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith.apply_smul
statement:
theorem apply_smul (hF : IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith ρ F) (γ : Γ) (τ : ℍ) :
    F ((γ : SL(2, ℤ)) • τ) = hF.cocycle γ + ρ γ (F τ)

name: HeckeEis.IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith.cocycle_mem_coeffCocycles
statement: theorem cocycle_mem_coeffCocycles (hF : IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith ρ F) : hF.cocycle ∈ coeffCocycles ρ

name: HeckeEis.IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith.sub_eq_cocycle
statement:
theorem sub_eq_cocycle (hF : IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith ρ F) (γ : Γ) (τ : ℍ) :
    F ((γ : SL(2, ℤ)) • τ) - ρ γ (F τ) = hF.cocycle γ

name: HeckeEis.binaryFormRepSL_linePow
statement:
theorem binaryFormRepSL_linePow (g : SL(2, ℤ)) (τ : ℍ) :
    binaryFormRepSL ℂ n g (linePow n (τ : ℂ)) = (jFactor g τ) ^ n • linePow n ((g • τ : ℍ) : ℂ)

name: HeckeEis.binarySubst_line
statement:
theorem binarySubst_line (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) (τ : ℂ) :
    binarySubst ℂ M (C τ * X 0 + X 1)
      = C ((M 0 0 : ℂ) * τ + (M 0 1 : ℂ)) * X 0 + C ((M 1 0 : ℂ) * τ + (M 1 1 : ℂ)) * X 1

name: HeckeEis.coe_linePow
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_linePow (τ : ℂ) :
    ((linePow n τ : ↥(BinaryForm ℂ n)) : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) = (C τ * X 0 + X 1) ^ n

name: HeckeEis.coe_smul_mul_jFactor
statement:
theorem coe_smul_mul_jFactor (g : SL(2, ℤ)) (τ : ℍ) :
    ((g • τ : ℍ) : ℂ) * jFactor g τ
      = ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) 0 0 : ℂ) * (τ : ℂ) + ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) 0 1 : ℂ)

name: HeckeEis.eichlerShimuraMap_def
statement:
theorem eichlerShimuraMap_def (f : ℍ → ℂ) {F : ℍ → ↥(BinaryForm ℂ n)}
    (hEI : IsEichlerIntegral n f F)
    (hF : IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith ((binaryFormRepSL ℂ n).comp (Gamma0 N).subtype) F)
    (hpar : IsParabolicCocycle ((binaryFormRepSL ℂ n).comp (Gamma0 N).subtype) hF.cocycle) :
    ∃ (F₀ : ℍ → ↥(BinaryForm ℂ n)) (_ : IsEichlerIntegral n f F₀)
      (h₀ : IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith ((binaryFormRepSL ℂ n).comp (Gamma0 N).subtype) F₀)
      (hpar₀ : IsParabolicCocycle ((binaryFormRepSL ℂ n).comp (Gamma0 N).subtype) h₀.cocycle),
      eichlerShimuraMap n N f = coeffH1parMk _ ⟨h₀.cocycle, ⟨h₀.cocycle_mem_coeffCocycles, hpar₀⟩⟩

name: HeckeEis.eichlerShimuraMap_of_not_exists
statement:
theorem eichlerShimuraMap_of_not_exists (f : ℍ → ℂ)
    (h : ¬ ∃ F : ℍ → ↥(BinaryForm ℂ n), IsEichlerIntegral n f F ∧
      ∃ hF : IsEquivariantPrimitiveWith ((binaryFormRepSL ℂ n).comp (Gamma0 N).subtype) F,
        IsParabolicCocycle ((binaryFormRepSL ℂ n).comp (Gamma0 N).subtype) hF.cocycle) :
    eichlerShimuraMap n N f = 0

name: HeckeEis.gamma0NebenChar_apply
statement:
theorem gamma0NebenChar_apply (p M : ℕ) (hpM : p ∣ M) (κ : Type*) [CommRing κ] [CharP κ p] (e : ℕ)
    (γ : Gamma0 M) :
    gamma0NebenChar p M hpM κ e γ =
      (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) κ (ZMod.castHom hpM (ZMod p) (((γ : SL(2, ℤ)) 1 1 : ℤ) : ZMod M))) ^ e

name: HeckeEis.gamma0NebenRep_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gamma0NebenRep_apply (p M : ℕ) (hpM : p ∣ M) (κ : Type*) [CommRing κ] [CharP κ p] (e : ℕ)
    (γ : Gamma0 M) (v : κ) :
    gamma0NebenRep p M hpM κ e γ v = gamma0NebenChar p M hpM κ e γ * v

name: HeckeEis.gamma0NebenRep_zero
statement:
theorem gamma0NebenRep_zero (p M : ℕ) (hpM : p ∣ M) (κ : Type*) [CommRing κ] [CharP κ p] :
    gamma0NebenRep p M hpM κ 0 = 1

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.coassoc_dualComul
statement:
theorem coassoc_dualComul (φ : Module.Dual R A) :

        ((dualComul R A).rTensor (Module.Dual R A) (dualComul R A φ)) =
      (dualComul R A).lTensor (Module.Dual R A) (dualComul R A φ)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.comm_comp_dualComul

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.comm_dualComul

theorem dualDistrib_dualMap_mul'_tmul (f g : Module.Dual R A)

    TensorProduct.dualDistrib R (A ⊗[R] A) (A ⊗[R] A)
        (((LinearMap.mul' R A).dualMap f) ⊗ₜ[R] ((LinearMap.mul' R A).dualMap g)) W =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A (f ⊗ₜ[R] g)
        (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.mul' R A) (LinearMap.mul' R A) W)

statement:
theorem dualDistrib_map_dualDistrib_ttcomm :
    (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R (A ⊗[R] A) (A ⊗[R] A)) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A)
          (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A)) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.tensorTensorTensorComm R (Module.Dual R A) (Module.Dual R A)
          (Module.Dual R A) (Module.Dual R A)).toLinearMap =
      ((TensorProduct.tensorTensorTensorComm R A A A A).toLinearMap.dualMap) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R (A ⊗[R] A) (A ⊗[R] A)) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A)
          (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A))

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.dualDistrib_map_dualDistrib_ttcomm_apply
statement:
theorem dualDistrib_map_dualDistrib_ttcomm_apply
    (T : (Module.Dual R A ⊗[R] Module.Dual R A) ⊗[R]
      (Module.Dual R A ⊗[R] Module.Dual R A))
    (W : (A ⊗[R] A) ⊗[R] (A ⊗[R] A)) :
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib R (A ⊗[R] A) (A ⊗[R] A)
        (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A) (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A)
          (TensorProduct.tensorTensorTensorComm R (Module.Dual R A) (Module.Dual R A)
            (Module.Dual R A) (Module.Dual R A) T)) W =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib R (A ⊗[R] A) (A ⊗[R] A)
        (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A) (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A) T)
        (TensorProduct.tensorTensorTensorComm R A A A A W)

      (Module.Dual R A ⊗[R] Module.Dual R A)) (a b : A) :
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A
        (TensorProduct.map (dualMul R A) (dualMul R A) T) (a ⊗ₜ[R] b) =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib R (A ⊗[R] A) (A ⊗[R] A)
        (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A) (TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A) T)
        (Coalgebra.comul a ⊗ₜ[R] Coalgebra.comul b)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.congr_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem congr_symm_apply (e : A ≃ₐc[R] B) (φ : CartierDual R A) (b : B) :
    (congr e).symm φ b = φ (e.symm b)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.counit_comp_mapAlgHom
statement:
theorem counit_comp_mapAlgHom (f : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R (CartierDual R A)).comp (mapAlgHom f) = Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R (CartierDual R B)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.dualDistrib_map_map
statement:
theorem dualDistrib_map_map (f : A →ₐc[R] B) (φ ψ : CartierDual R B) (z : A ⊗[R] A) :
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib R B B (toDual R B φ ⊗ₜ[R] toDual R B ψ)
        (TensorProduct.map (f : A →ₗ[R] B) (f : A →ₗ[R] B) z) =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A (toDual R A (mapLinear f φ) ⊗ₜ[R] toDual R A (mapLinear f ψ)) z

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.dualDistrib_map_mapAlgHom
statement:
theorem dualDistrib_map_mapAlgHom (f : A →ₐc[R] B) (w : CartierDual R B ⊗[R] CartierDual R B) (a b : A) :
    TensorProduct.dualDistrib R A A
        (TensorProduct.map (toDual R A).toLinearMap (toDual R A).toLinearMap
          (TensorProduct.map (mapLinear f) (mapLinear f) w)) (a ⊗ₜ[R] b) =
      TensorProduct.dualDistrib R B B
        (TensorProduct.map (toDual R B).toLinearMap (toDual R B).toLinearMap w) (f a ⊗ₜ[R] f b)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.mapAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapAlgHom_apply (f : A →ₐc[R] B) (φ : CartierDual R B) (a : A) :
    mapAlgHom f φ a = φ (f a)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.mapLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapLinear_apply (f : A →ₐc[R] B) (φ : CartierDual R B) (a : A) :
    mapLinear f φ a = φ (f a)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.mapLinear_mul
statement:
theorem mapLinear_mul (f : A →ₐc[R] B) (φ ψ : CartierDual R B) :
    mapLinear f (φ * ψ) = mapLinear f φ * mapLinear f ψ

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.mapLinear_one
statement: theorem mapLinear_one (f : A →ₐc[R] B) : mapLinear f 1 = 1

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.map_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem map_apply (f : A →ₐc[R] B) (φ : CartierDual R B) (a : A) : map f φ a = φ (f a)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.map_comp
statement: theorem map_comp (g : B →ₐc[R] C) (f : A →ₐc[R] B) : map (g.comp f) = (map f).comp (map g)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.map_comp_comul_mapAlgHom
statement:
theorem map_comp_comul_mapAlgHom (f : A →ₐc[R] B) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (mapAlgHom f) (mapAlgHom f)).comp (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R (CartierDual R B)) =
      (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R (CartierDual R A)).comp (mapAlgHom f)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map (BialgHom.id R A) = BialgHom.id R (CartierDual R A)

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.pairing_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem pairing_apply (φ : CartierDual R A) (a : A) : pairing R A φ a = φ a

name: Tengoku.FltAnthropic.CartierDual.toDual_map
statement:
theorem toDual_map (f : A →ₐc[R] B) (φ : CartierDual R B) :
    toDual R A (map f φ) = (f : A →ₗ[R] B).dualMap (toDual R B φ)

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.act_add_linearMap
statement:
theorem act_add_linearMap (a b : F) :
    ((σ.act (a + b) : H →ₐ[R] H).toLinearMap) =
      LinearMap.mul' R H ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (σ.act a : H →ₐ[R] H).toLinearMap (σ.act b : H →ₐ[R] H).toLinearMap
        ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.act_comp_act_inv
statement: theorem act_comp_act_inv (a : Fˣ) : (σ.act a).comp (σ.act (a⁻¹ : Fˣ)) = BialgHom.id R H

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.act_inv_comp_act
statement: theorem act_inv_comp_act (a : Fˣ) : (σ.act (a⁻¹ : Fˣ)).comp (σ.act a) = BialgHom.id R H

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.addChar_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem addChar_apply (a : F) : σ.addChar a = WithConv.toConv (σ.act a : H →ₐ[R] H)

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.point_pow_ringChar_eq_one
statement:
theorem point_pow_ringChar_eq_one (T : Type x) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] T)) :
    f ^ ringChar F = 1

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.toConv_act_nsmul
statement:
theorem toConv_act_nsmul (n : ℕ) (a : F) :
    WithConv.toConv (σ.act (n • a) : H →ₐ[R] H) = WithConv.toConv (σ.act a : H →ₐ[R] H) ^ n

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.toConv_act_pow_ringChar
statement:
theorem toConv_act_pow_ringChar (a : F) :
    WithConv.toConv (σ.act a : H →ₐ[R] H) ^ ringChar F = 1

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.toConv_id_pow_ringChar
statement:
theorem toConv_id_pow_ringChar :
    WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.id R H) ^ ringChar F = (1 : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] H))

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.unitsAct_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem unitsAct_apply (a : Fˣ) (x : H) : σ.unitsAct a x = σ.act a x

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.unitsAct_mul
statement: theorem unitsAct_mul (a b : Fˣ) : σ.unitsAct (a * b) = (σ.unitsAct b).trans (σ.unitsAct a)

name: HopfAlgebra.FVectStructure.unitsAct_one
statement: theorem unitsAct_one : σ.unitsAct 1 = BialgEquiv.refl R H

name: HopfAlgebra.IsFCompatible.apply
statement:
theorem apply {σ : FVectStructure F R H} {σ' : FVectStructure F R H'} {u : H →ₐc[R] H'}
    (hu : IsFCompatible σ σ' u) (a : F) (x : H) : u (σ.act a x) = σ'.act a (u x)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsFCompatible.comp
HopfAlgebra.IsFCompatible.id
statement: theorem id (σ : FVectStructure F R H) : IsFCompatible σ σ (BialgHom.id R H)

name: HopfAlgebra.canAlgHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem canAlgHom_tmul (π : A →ₐc[R] B) (a a' : A) :
    canAlgHom π (a ⊗ₜ[R] a') = (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) * coaction π a'

name: HopfAlgebra.canMap_apply
statement: theorem canMap_apply (π : A →ₐc[R] B) (z : A ⊗[R] A) : canMap π z = canAlgHom π z

name: HopfAlgebra.canMap_eq_zero_of_mem_span
statement:
theorem canMap_eq_zero_of_mem_span (π : A →ₐc[R] B) {z : A ⊗[R] A}
    (hz : z ∈ Submodule.span R (balancingRelations π)) : canMap π z = 0

name: HopfAlgebra.canMap_mul_tmul
statement:
theorem canMap_mul_tmul (π : A →ₐc[R] B) (a a' : A) {h : A} (hh : h ∈ hopfKer π) :
    canMap π ((a * h) ⊗ₜ[R] a') = canMap π (a ⊗ₜ[R] (h * a'))

name: HopfAlgebra.canMap_one_tmul
statement: theorem canMap_one_tmul (π : A →ₐc[R] B) (a : A) : canMap π (1 ⊗ₜ[R] a) = coaction π a

name: HopfAlgebra.canMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem canMap_tmul (π : A →ₐc[R] B) (a a' : A) :
    canMap π (a ⊗ₜ[R] a') = (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) * coaction π a'

name: HopfAlgebra.canMap_tmul_one
statement: theorem canMap_tmul_one (π : A →ₐc[R] B) (a : A) : canMap π (a ⊗ₜ[R] 1) = a ⊗ₜ[R] 1

name: HopfAlgebra.coaction_apply
statement:
theorem coaction_apply (π : A →ₐc[R] B) (a : A) :
    coaction π a = Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R A) (π : A →ₐ[R] B) (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) a)

name: HopfAlgebra.coaction_eq_of_mem
statement: theorem coaction_eq_of_mem (π : A →ₐc[R] B) {a : A} (h : a ∈ hopfKer π) : coaction π a = a ⊗ₜ[R] 1

name: HopfAlgebra.mem_hopfKer_iff
statement: theorem mem_hopfKer_iff (π : A →ₐc[R] B) (a : A) : a ∈ hopfKer π ↔ coaction π a = a ⊗ₜ[R] 1

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.antipode_mem
statement:
theorem antipode_mem [Coalgebra.IsCocomm R A] {a : A} (ha : a ∈ hopfKer π) :
    antipode R a ∈ hopfKer π

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.coaction_eq_map
statement:
theorem coaction_eq_map (a : A) :
    coaction π a
      = TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (π : A →ₐc[R] B).toLinearMap (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) a)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.coaction_repr
statement:
theorem coaction_repr {a : A} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr R a ι) :
    coaction π a = ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index, 𝓡.left i ⊗ₜ[R] π (𝓡.right i)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.coe_antipode
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_antipode (s : ↥(hopfKer π)) : ((antipode R s : ↥(hopfKer π)) : A) = antipode R (s : A)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.coe_antipodeK
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_antipodeK (s : ↥(hopfKer π)) : ((antipodeK π s : ↥(hopfKer π)) : A) = antipode R (s : A)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.comul_antipode
statement:
theorem comul_antipode (a : A) :
    comul (antipode R a)
      = TensorProduct.comm R A A
          (TensorProduct.map (antipode R) (antipode R) (comul a))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.comul_antipode_eq_sum
statement:
theorem comul_antipode_eq_sum {a : A} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr R a ι) :
    comul (antipode R a)
      = ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index, antipode R (𝓡.right i) ⊗ₜ[R] antipode R (𝓡.left i)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.comul_coe_mem_range
statement:
theorem comul_coe_mem_range (s : ↥(hopfKer π)) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (s : A) ∈ LinearMap.range (ι₂ π)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.comul_comp_antipode
statement:
theorem comul_comp_antipode :
    comul ∘ₗ antipode R
      = (TensorProduct.comm R A A).toLinearMap
          ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (antipode R) (antipode R) ∘ₗ comul

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.comul_def
statement: theorem comul_def (s : ↥(hopfKer π)) : Coalgebra.comul (R := R) s = comulK π s

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.counitK_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem counitK_apply (s : ↥(hopfKer π)) : counitK π s = Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (s : A)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.counit_coe
statement: theorem counit_coe (s : ↥(hopfKer π)) : Coalgebra.counit (R := R) s = Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (s : A)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.exact_valL_rhoSub
statement: theorem exact_valL_rhoSub : Function.Exact (valL π) (rhoSub π)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.hopfKerVal_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem hopfKerVal_apply (s : ↥(hopfKer π)) : hopfKerVal π s = (s : A)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.hopfKerVal_injective
statement: theorem hopfKerVal_injective : Function.Injective (hopfKerVal π)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.lTensor_coaction_comul
statement:
theorem lTensor_coaction_comul {a : A} (ha : a ∈ hopfKer π) :
    (coaction π).toLinearMap.lTensor A (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) a)
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R A A B) (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.lTensor_counitK
statement:
theorem lTensor_counitK (z : ↥(hopfKer π) ⊗[R] ↥(hopfKer π)) :
    (valL π).rTensor R ((counitK π).lTensor ↥(hopfKer π) z)
      = (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := A)).lTensor A (ι₂ π z)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.lTensor_rhoSub_comul
statement:
theorem lTensor_rhoSub_comul {a : A} (ha : a ∈ hopfKer π) :
    (rhoSub π).lTensor A (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) a) = 0

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.map_antipode
statement: theorem map_antipode (π : A →ₐc[R] B) (a : A) : π (antipode R a) = antipode R (π a)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.map_comm
statement:
theorem map_comm {M N P Q : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P] [AddCommGroup Q]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] [Module R P] [Module R Q] (f : M →ₗ[R] P) (g : N →ₗ[R] Q) (z : N ⊗[R] M) :
    TensorProduct.map f g (TensorProduct.comm R N M z) = TensorProduct.comm R Q P (TensorProduct.map g f z)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.map_toLinearMap_id_comul
statement:
theorem map_toLinearMap_id_comul [Coalgebra.IsCocomm R A] (x : A) :
    TensorProduct.map (π : A →ₐc[R] B).toLinearMap LinearMap.id (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x)
      = TensorProduct.comm R A B (coaction π x)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.map_toLinearMap_id_comul'
statement:
theorem map_toLinearMap_id_comul' [Coalgebra.IsCocomm R A] (x : A) :
    TensorProduct.map (π : A →ₐc[R] B).toLinearMap LinearMap.id (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x)
      = (TensorProduct.comm R A B).toLinearMap (coaction π x)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.map_val_val_comul
statement:
theorem map_val_val_comul (s : ↥(hopfKer π)) :
    TensorProduct.map (valL π) (valL π) (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) s) = Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (s : A)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.mem_hopfKer_iff_rhoSub
statement: theorem mem_hopfKer_iff_rhoSub (a : A) : a ∈ hopfKer π ↔ rhoSub π a = 0

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.rTensor_coaction_comul
statement:
theorem rTensor_coaction_comul [Coalgebra.IsCocomm R A] (a : A) :
    (coaction π).toLinearMap.rTensor A (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) a)
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R A B A).symm.toLinearMap
          ((TensorProduct.comm R A B).toLinearMap.lTensor A
            ((coaction π).toLinearMap.lTensor A (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) a)))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.rTensor_counitK
statement:
theorem rTensor_counitK (z : ↥(hopfKer π) ⊗[R] ↥(hopfKer π)) :
    (valL π).lTensor R ((counitK π).rTensor ↥(hopfKer π) z)
      = (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := A)).rTensor A (ι₂ π z)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.rTensor_rhoSub_comul
statement:
theorem rTensor_rhoSub_comul [Coalgebra.IsCocomm R A] {a : A} (ha : a ∈ hopfKer π) :
    (rhoSub π).rTensor A (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) a) = 0

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.rhoSub_apply
statement: theorem rhoSub_apply (a : A) : rhoSub π a = coaction π a - a ⊗ₜ[R] 1

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.toConv_comm_map_antipode_comul_mul_toConv_comul
statement:
theorem toConv_comm_map_antipode_comul_mul_toConv_comul :
    toConv ((TensorProduct.comm R A A).toLinearMap
          ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (antipode R) (antipode R) ∘ₗ comul)
        * toConv (comul : A →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] A)
      = (1 : WithConv (A →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] A))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.toConv_comul_mul_toConv_comul_comp_antipode
statement:
theorem toConv_comul_mul_toConv_comul_comp_antipode :
    toConv (comul : A →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] A)
        * toConv (comul ∘ₗ antipode R : A →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] A)
      = (1 : WithConv (A →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] A))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.toConv_includeLeft_comp_antipode_mul_toConv_includeLeft
statement:
theorem toConv_includeLeft_comp_antipode_mul_toConv_includeLeft :
    toConv ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] A).toLinearMap ∘ₗ antipode R)
        * toConv (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] A).toLinearMap
      = (1 : WithConv (A →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] A))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.toConv_includeLeft_mul_toConv_includeRight
statement:
theorem toConv_includeLeft_mul_toConv_includeRight :
    toConv (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] A).toLinearMap
        * toConv (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] A).toLinearMap
      = toConv (comul : A →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] A)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.toConv_includeRight_comp_antipode_mul_toConv_includeLeft_comp_antipode
statement:
theorem toConv_includeRight_comp_antipode_mul_toConv_includeLeft_comp_antipode :
    toConv ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] A).toLinearMap ∘ₗ antipode R)
        * toConv
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] A).toLinearMap ∘ₗ antipode R)
      = toConv ((TensorProduct.comm R A A).toLinearMap
          ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (antipode R) (antipode R) ∘ₗ comul)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.toConv_includeRight_comp_antipode_mul_toConv_includeRight
statement:
theorem toConv_includeRight_comp_antipode_mul_toConv_includeRight :
    toConv ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] A).toLinearMap ∘ₗ antipode R)
        * toConv (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] A).toLinearMap
      = (1 : WithConv (A →ₗ[R] A ⊗[R] A))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.toLinearMap_apply'
statement: theorem toLinearMap_apply' (x : A) : (π : A →ₐc[R] B).toLinearMap x = π x

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.valL_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem valL_apply (s : ↥(hopfKer π)) : valL π s = (s : A)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.val_mul'_lTensor_antipodeK
statement:
theorem val_mul'_lTensor_antipodeK (z : ↥(hopfKer π) ⊗[R] ↥(hopfKer π)) :
    ((LinearMap.mul' R ↥(hopfKer π) ((antipodeK π).lTensor _ z) : ↥(hopfKer π)) : A)
      = LinearMap.mul' R A ((antipode R (A := A)).lTensor A (ι₂ π z))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfKerHopf.val_mul'_rTensor_antipodeK
statement:
theorem val_mul'_rTensor_antipodeK (z : ↥(hopfKer π) ⊗[R] ↥(hopfKer π)) :
    ((LinearMap.mul' R ↥(hopfKer π) ((antipodeK π).rTensor _ z) : ↥(hopfKer π)) : A)
      = LinearMap.mul' R A ((antipode R (A := A)).rTensor A (ι₂ π z))

name: HopfOrder.algebraMap_counitS
statement:
theorem algebraMap_counitS
    (hcounit : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.counit (R := K) x ∈ (algebraMap R K).range) (t : ↥S) :
    algebraMap R K (counitS hcounit t) = Coalgebra.counit (R := K) (t : A)

name: HopfOrder.algebraMap_counit_eq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_counit_eq
    (hcomul : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.comul (R := K) x ∈
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)).range)
    (hcounit : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.counit (R := K) x ∈ (algebraMap R K).range) (t : ↥S) :
    letI : Coalgebra R ↥S

name: HopfOrder.antipode_baseChangeHom
statement:
theorem antipode_baseChangeHom
    (hcomul : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.comul (R := K) x ∈
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)).range)
    (hcounit : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.counit (R := K) x ∈ (algebraMap R K).range)
    (hantipode : ∀ x ∈ S, HopfAlgebra.antipode K x ∈ S) (x : K ⊗[R] ↥S) :
    letI : HopfAlgebra R ↥S

name: HopfOrder.baseChangeBialgEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem baseChangeBialgEquiv_apply
    (hspan : Submodule.span K (S : Set A) = ⊤)
    (hcomul : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.comul (R := K) x ∈
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)).range)
    (hcounit : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.counit (R := K) x ∈ (algebraMap R K).range) (x : K ⊗[R] ↥S) :
    baseChangeBialgEquiv S hspan hcomul hcounit x = baseChangeHom S x

name: HopfOrder.baseChangeEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma baseChangeEquiv_apply (hspan : Submodule.span K (S : Set A) = ⊤) (x : K ⊗[R] ↥S) :
    baseChangeEquiv S hspan x = baseChangeHom S x

name: HopfOrder.baseChangeEquiv_tmul
statement:
lemma baseChangeEquiv_tmul (hspan : Submodule.span K (S : Set A) = ⊤) (k : K) (t : ↥S) :
    baseChangeEquiv S hspan (k ⊗ₜ[R] t) = k • (t : A)

name: HopfOrder.baseChangeHom_injective
statement: theorem baseChangeHom_injective : Function.Injective (baseChangeHom (K := K) S)

name: HopfOrder.baseChangeHom_one_tmul
statement: lemma baseChangeHom_one_tmul (t : ↥S) : baseChangeHom S ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] t) = (t : A)

name: HopfOrder.baseChangeHom_surjective
statement:
theorem baseChangeHom_surjective (hspan : Submodule.span K (S : Set A) = ⊤) :

    (hcounit : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.counit (R := K) x ∈ (algebraMap R K).range)
    (hantipode : ∀ x ∈ S, HopfAlgebra.antipode K x ∈ S) (h : ↥S) :
    letI : HopfAlgebra R ↥S

name: HopfOrder.val_comul
statement:
theorem val_comul
    (hcomul : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.comul (R := K) x ∈
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)).range)
    (hcounit : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.counit (R := K) x ∈ (algebraMap R K).range)
    (hantipode : ∀ x ∈ S, HopfAlgebra.antipode K x ∈ S) (h : ↥S) :
    letI : HopfAlgebra R ↥S

name: HopfOrder.val_counit
statement:
theorem val_counit
    (hcomul : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.comul (R := K) x ∈
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[K] A ⊗[K] A).restrictScalars R).comp S.val)).range)
    (hcounit : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.counit (R := K) x ∈ (algebraMap R K).range)
    (hantipode : ∀ x ∈ S, HopfAlgebra.antipode K x ∈ S) (h : ↥S) :
    letI : HopfAlgebra R ↥S

name: HopfOrder.val_lid_rTensor_counitS
statement:
lemma val_lid_rTensor_counitS
    (hcounit : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.counit (R := K) x ∈ (algebraMap R K).range)
    (z : ↥S ⊗[R] ↥S) :
    ((TensorProduct.lid R ↥S ((counitS hcounit).rTensor ↥S z) : ↥S) : A)
      = TensorProduct.lid K A
          ((Coalgebra.counit (R := K) (A := A)).rTensor A (doubleCmp S z))

name: HopfOrder.val_mul'_lTensor_antipodeS
statement:
lemma val_mul'_lTensor_antipodeS (hantipode : ∀ x ∈ S, HopfAlgebra.antipode K x ∈ S) (z : ↥S ⊗[R] ↥S) :
    ((LinearMap.mul' R ↥S ((antipodeS hantipode).lTensor ↥S z) : ↥S) : A)
      = LinearMap.mul' K A ((HopfAlgebra.antipode K (A := A)).lTensor A (doubleCmp S z))

name: HopfOrder.val_mul'_rTensor_antipodeS
statement:
lemma val_mul'_rTensor_antipodeS (hantipode : ∀ x ∈ S, HopfAlgebra.antipode K x ∈ S) (z : ↥S ⊗[R] ↥S) :
    ((LinearMap.mul' R ↥S ((antipodeS hantipode).rTensor ↥S z) : ↥S) : A)
      = LinearMap.mul' K A ((HopfAlgebra.antipode K (A := A)).rTensor A (doubleCmp S z))

name: HopfOrder.val_rid_lTensor_counitS
statement:
lemma val_rid_lTensor_counitS
    (hcounit : ∀ x ∈ S, Coalgebra.counit (R := K) x ∈ (algebraMap R K).range)
    (z : ↥S ⊗[R] ↥S) :
    ((TensorProduct.rid R ↥S ((counitS hcounit).lTensor ↥S z) : ↥S) : A)
      = TensorProduct.rid K A
          ((Coalgebra.counit (R := K) (A := A)).lTensor A (doubleCmp S z))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.algebraMap_mem_augIdealMap
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_augIdealMap {a : A} (ha : counit (R := k) a = 0) :
    algebraMap A B a ∈ augIdealMap k A B

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.antipodeAlgHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem antipodeAlgHom_apply (x : C) : antipodeAlgHom k C x = antipode k x

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.augIdealMap_le_comap
statement:
theorem augIdealMap_le_comap :
    augIdealMap k A B ≤ (augIdealMap k A B').comap (algebraMap B B')

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.augIdealMap_le_ker_invAux
statement:
theorem augIdealMap_le_ker_invAux :
    augIdealMap k A B ≤ RingHom.ker (invAux k A B C)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.comap_translate_augIdeal
statement:
theorem comap_translate_augIdeal (φ : C →ₐ[k] k) :
    (RingHom.ker (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k C)).comap (translate k C φ) = RingHom.ker φ

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.comp_antipodeAlgHom_convMul
statement:
theorem comp_antipodeAlgHom_convMul (φ : C →ₐ[k] L) :
    toConv (φ.comp (antipodeAlgHom k C)) * toConv φ = 1

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.comp_translate
statement:
theorem comp_translate (u φ : C →ₐ[k] k) :
    u.comp (translate k C φ) = ofConv (toConv u * toConv φ)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.convMul_apply'
statement:
theorem convMul_apply' (φ ψ : C →ₐ[k] k) {x : C} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k x ι) :
    ofConv (toConv φ * toConv ψ) x = ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index, φ (𝓡.left i) * ψ (𝓡.right i)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.convMul_comp_antipodeAlgHom
statement:
theorem convMul_comp_antipodeAlgHom (φ : C →ₐ[k] L) :
    toConv φ * toConv (φ.comp (antipodeAlgHom k C)) = 1

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.counit_translate
statement:
theorem counit_translate (φ : C →ₐ[k] k) (x : C) :
    counit (R := k) (translate k C φ x) = φ x

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.fwdAux_algebraMap
statement:
theorem fwdAux_algebraMap (a : A) :
    fwdAux k A B C (algebraMap A B a) = algebraMap A C a ⊗ₜ[k] 1

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.fwdAux_algebraMap'
statement:
theorem fwdAux_algebraMap' (b : B) :
    fwdAux k A B' C (algebraMap B B' b) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id C C) (quotientMap k A B B') (fwdAux k A B C b)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.fwdAux_algebraMap_eq_sum
statement:
theorem fwdAux_algebraMap_eq_sum {a : A} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k a ι) :
    fwdAux k A B C (algebraMap A B a) = ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index,
      algebraMap A C (𝓡.left i) ⊗ₜ[k]
        Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (augIdealMap k A B) (algebraMap A B (𝓡.right i))

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.fwdAux_apply
statement:
theorem fwdAux_apply {b : B} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k b ι) :
    fwdAux k A B C b = ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index,
      algebraMap B C (𝓡.left i) ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk (augIdealMap k A B) (𝓡.right i)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.fwdB_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem fwdB_apply (b : B) : fwdB k A B C b = fwdAux k A B C b

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisEquiv_apply
statement: theorem galoisEquiv_apply (z : C ⊗[A] B) : galoisEquiv k A B C z = galoisFwd k A B C z

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem galoisEquiv_naturality (z : C ⊗[A] B) :
    galoisEquiv k A B' C
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id C C) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B B') z) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id C C) (quotientMap k A B B') (galoisEquiv k A B C z)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisEquiv_one_tmul
statement: theorem galoisEquiv_one_tmul (b : B) : galoisEquiv k A B C (1 ⊗ₜ[A] b) = fwdAux k A B C b

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem galoisEquiv_symm_apply (z : C ⊗[k] (B ⧸ augIdealMap k A B)) :
    (galoisEquiv k A B C).symm z = galoisInv k A B C z

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem galoisEquiv_tmul (c : C) (b : B) :
    galoisEquiv k A B C (c ⊗ₜ[A] b) = (c ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : B ⧸ augIdealMap k A B)) * fwdAux k A B C b

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisFwd_comp_galoisInv
statement:
theorem galoisFwd_comp_galoisInv :
    (galoisFwd k A B C).comp (galoisInv k A B C) = AlgHom.id C _

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisFwd_invAux
statement:
theorem galoisFwd_invAux (b : B) :
    galoisFwd k A B C (invAux k A B C b) = 1 ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk (augIdealMap k A B) b

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisFwd_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem galoisFwd_tmul (c : C) (b : B) :
    galoisFwd k A B C (c ⊗ₜ[A] b) = (c ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : B ⧸ augIdealMap k A B)) * fwdAux k A B C b

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisInv_comp_galoisFwd
statement:
theorem galoisInv_comp_galoisFwd :
    (galoisInv k A B C).comp (galoisFwd k A B C) = AlgHom.id C (C ⊗[A] B)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisInv_fwdAux
statement: theorem galoisInv_fwdAux (b : B) : galoisInv k A B C (fwdAux k A B C b) = 1 ⊗ₜ[A] b

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.galoisInv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem galoisInv_tmul (c : C) (q : B ⧸ augIdealMap k A B) :
    galoisInv k A B C (c ⊗ₜ[k] q) = (c ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)) * invQuot k A B C q

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.invAux_algebraMap_eq_sum
statement:
theorem invAux_algebraMap_eq_sum {a : A} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k a ι) :
    invAux k A B C (algebraMap A B a) =
      ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index, antipode k (algebraMap A C (𝓡.left i)) ⊗ₜ[A] algebraMap A B (𝓡.right i)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.invAux_algebraMap_of_counit_eq_zero
statement:
theorem invAux_algebraMap_of_counit_eq_zero {a : A} (ha : counit (R := k) a = 0) :
    invAux k A B C (algebraMap A B a) = 0

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.invAux_apply
statement:
theorem invAux_apply {b : B} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k b ι) :
    invAux k A B C b = ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index, antipode k (algebraMap B C (𝓡.left i)) ⊗ₜ[A] 𝓡.right i

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.invQuot_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem invQuot_mk (b : B) :
    invQuot k A B C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augIdealMap k A B) b) = invAux k A B C b

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.quotientMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientMap_mk (b : B) :
    quotientMap k A B B' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augIdealMap k A B) b) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (augIdealMap k A B') (algebraMap B B' b)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.tmul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem tmul_algebraMap (c : C) (a : A) :
    c ⊗ₜ[A] algebraMap A B a = (algebraMap A C a * c) ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.translateEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem translateEquiv_apply (φ : C →ₐ[k] k) (x : C) :
    translateEquiv k C φ x = translate k C φ x

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.translate_algebraMap
statement:
theorem translate_algebraMap
    (hcomul : ∀ a : A, comul (R := k) (algebraMap A C a) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C)
        (comul (R := k) a))
    (φ : C →ₐ[k] k) (a : A) :
    translate k C φ (algebraMap A C a) =
      algebraMap A C (translate k A (φ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C)) a)

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.translate_antipode_comp_translate
statement:
theorem translate_antipode_comp_translate (φ : C →ₐ[k] k) :
    (translate k C (φ.comp (antipodeAlgHom k C))).comp (translate k C φ) = AlgHom.id k C

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.translate_apply
statement:
theorem translate_apply {x : C} (φ : C →ₐ[k] k) {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k x ι) :
    translate k C φ x = ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index, φ (𝓡.right i) • 𝓡.left i

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.translate_comp_translate_antipode
statement:
theorem translate_comp_translate_antipode (φ : C →ₐ[k] k) :
    (translate k C φ).comp (translate k C (φ.comp (antipodeAlgHom k C))) = AlgHom.id k C

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.translate_one
statement: theorem translate_one : translate k C (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k C) = AlgHom.id k C

name: HopfAlgebra.HopfTower.translate_translate
statement:
theorem translate_translate (φ ψ : C →ₐ[k] k) (x : C) :
    translate k C φ (translate k C ψ x) = translate k C (ofConv (toConv φ * toConv ψ)) x

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.coe_antipode
statement:
theorem coe_antipode (s : ↥K) :
    ((letI := hK.hopfAlgebra; antipode k s : ↥K) : H) = antipode k (s : H)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.coe_antipodeK
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_antipodeK (s : ↥K) : ((hK.antipodeK s : ↥K) : H) = antipode k (s : H)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.comul_coe_mem_range
statement: theorem comul_coe_mem_range (s : ↥K) : comul (R := k) (s : H) ∈ LinearMap.range (ι₂ K)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.comul_def
statement: theorem comul_def (s : ↥K) : (letI := hK.coalgebra; comul (R := k) s) = hK.comulK s

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.counitK_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem counitK_apply (s : ↥K) : counitK K s = counit (R := k) (s : H)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.counit_coe
statement: theorem counit_coe (s : ↥K) : (letI := hK.coalgebra; counit (R := k) s) = counit (R := k) (s : H)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.isHopfTower
statement: theorem isHopfTower : letI

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.lTensor_counitK
statement:
theorem lTensor_counitK (z : ↥K ⊗[k] ↥K) :
    K.val.toLinearMap.rTensor k ((counitK K).lTensor ↥K z)
      = (counit (R := k) (A := H)).lTensor H (ι₂ K z)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.map_val_val_comul
statement:
theorem map_val_val_comul (s : ↥K) :
    TensorProduct.map K.val.toLinearMap K.val.toLinearMap (letI := hK.coalgebra; comul (R := k) s) =
      comul (R := k) (s : H)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.rTensor_counitK
statement:
theorem rTensor_counitK (z : ↥K ⊗[k] ↥K) :
    K.val.toLinearMap.lTensor k ((counitK K).rTensor ↥K z)
      = (counit (R := k) (A := H)).rTensor H (ι₂ K z)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.val_mul'_lTensor_antipodeK
statement:
theorem val_mul'_lTensor_antipodeK (z : ↥K ⊗[k] ↥K) :
    ((LinearMap.mul' k ↥K (hK.antipodeK.lTensor _ z) : ↥K) : H)
      = LinearMap.mul' k H ((antipode k (A := H)).lTensor H (ι₂ K z))

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfSubalgebra.val_mul'_rTensor_antipodeK
statement:
theorem val_mul'_rTensor_antipodeK (z : ↥K ⊗[k] ↥K) :
    ((LinearMap.mul' k ↥K (hK.antipodeK.rTensor _ z) : ↥K) : H)
      = LinearMap.mul' k H ((antipode k (A := H)).rTensor H (ι₂ K z))

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfTower.algebraMap_antipode
statement:
theorem algebraMap_antipode (a : A) :
    algebraMap A C (antipode k a) = antipode k (algebraMap A C a)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfTower.coe_toBialgHom
statement:
theorem coe_toBialgHom : ((toBialgHom k A C : A →ₐc[k] C) : A →ₐ[k] C) =
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfTower.reprMap_index
statement: @[simp] theorem reprMap_index {a : A} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k a ι) : (reprMap k A C 𝓡).index = 𝓡.index

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfTower.reprMap_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem reprMap_left {a : A} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k a ι) (i : ι) :
    (reprMap k A C 𝓡).left i = algebraMap A C (𝓡.left i)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfTower.reprMap_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem reprMap_right {a : A} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k a ι) (i : ι) :
    (reprMap k A C 𝓡).right i = algebraMap A C (𝓡.right i)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfTower.sum_tmul_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem sum_tmul_algebraMap_eq {a : A} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k a ι) :
    ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index, algebraMap A C (𝓡.left i) ⊗ₜ[k] algebraMap A C (𝓡.right i) =
      comul (R := k) (algebraMap A C a)

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfTower.toBialgHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem toBialgHom_apply (a : A) : toBialgHom k A C a = algebraMap A C a

name: HopfAlgebra.IsHopfTower.trans
statement:
theorem trans (B : Type*) [CommRing B] [HopfAlgebra k B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C]
    [IsScalarTower k A B] [IsScalarTower k B C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
    [IsHopfTower k A B] [IsHopfTower k B C] : IsHopfTower k A C

name: HopfAlgebra.augIdeal_ne_top
statement: theorem augIdeal_ne_top [Nontrivial k] : augIdeal k A ≠ ⊤

name: HopfAlgebra.mem_augIdeal
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_augIdeal {a : A} : a ∈ augIdeal k A ↔ counit (R := k) a = 0

name: HopfAlgebra.sub_algebraMap_counit_mem_augIdeal
statement:
theorem sub_algebraMap_counit_mem_augIdeal (a : A) :
    a - algebraMap k A (counit (R := k) a) ∈ augIdeal k A

name: HopfAlgebra.sum_counit_right_smul
statement:
theorem sum_counit_right_smul {a : A} {ι : Type*} (𝓡 : Coalgebra.Repr k a ι) :
    ∑ i ∈ 𝓡.index, counit (R := k) (𝓡.right i) • 𝓡.left i = a

name: HopfAlgebra.KummerRadicands.carry_comm
statement: theorem carry_comm (k k' : Fin t → ZMod n) : carry u k k' = carry u k' k

name: HopfAlgebra.KummerRadicands.carry_mul_carry_add
statement:
theorem carry_mul_carry_add (k k' k'' : Fin t → ZMod n) :
    carry u k k' * carry u (k + k') k'' = carry u k' k'' * carry u k (k' + k'')

name: HopfAlgebra.KummerRadicands.carry_pow_mul_rad_mul_rad
statement:
theorem carry_pow_mul_rad_mul_rad (k k' : Fin t → ZMod n) :
    carry u k k' ^ n * (rad u k * rad u k') = rad u (k + k')

name: HopfAlgebra.KummerRadicands.carry_zero_left
statement: theorem carry_zero_left (k : Fin t → ZMod n) : carry u 0 k = 1

name: HopfAlgebra.KummerRadicands.carry_zero_right
statement: theorem carry_zero_right (k : Fin t → ZMod n) : carry u k 0 = 1

name: HopfAlgebra.KummerRadicands.div_add_mod_add_div
statement:
theorem div_add_mod_add_div (a b c : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (a + b) / n + ((a + b) % n + c) / n = (b + c) / n + (a + (b + c) % n) / n

name: HopfAlgebra.KummerRadicands.inv_pow_div_pow_mul
statement:
theorem inv_pow_div_pow_mul (v : Oˣ) (a b : ZMod n) :
    (v⁻¹ ^ ((a.val + b.val) / n)) ^ n * (v ^ a.val * v ^ b.val) = v ^ (a + b).val

name: HopfAlgebra.KummerRadicands.rad_zero
statement: theorem rad_zero : rad u (0 : Fin t → ZMod n) = 1

name: HopfAlgebra.FVect.DescentDatum.gTensor_tmul
statement:
theorem gTensor_tmul (Dd : DescentDatum R' F B fv R Γ) (σ : Γ) (b₁ b₂ : B) :
    Dd.gTensor σ (b₁ ⊗ₜ[R'] b₂) = Dd.g σ b₁ ⊗ₜ[R'] Dd.g σ b₂

name: HopfAlgebra.TorsorGrading.blockComponents_eq
statement: theorem blockComponents_eq : blockComponents Λ π = gradingComponents Λ π

name: HopfAlgebra.TorsorGrading.componentProj_apply
statement:
theorem componentProj_apply (j : Λ) (t : H) :
    componentProj Λ π j t = gradingComponents Λ π t (Multiplicative.ofAdd j)

name: HopfAlgebra.TorsorGrading.gradingCoaction_apply
statement:
theorem gradingCoaction_apply (t : H) :
    gradingCoaction Λ π t = (LinearMap.rTensor H π.toLinearMap) ((Coalgebra.comul (R := R)) t)

name: HopfAlgebra.TorsorGrading.gradingComponents_apply
statement:
theorem gradingComponents_apply (t : H) :
    gradingComponents Λ π t =
      (TensorProduct.finsuppScalarLeft R H (Multiplicative Λ))
        (((MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv R).rTensor H) (gradingCoaction Λ π t))

name: HopfAlgebra.TorsorGrading.mem_blockPiece_iff
statement:
theorem mem_blockPiece_iff (ε : H) (j : Λ) (t : H) :
    t ∈ blockPiece Λ π ε j ↔ t ∈ gradedPiece Λ π j ∧ t * ε = t

name: HopfAlgebra.TorsorGrading.mem_gradedPiece_iff
statement:
theorem mem_gradedPiece_iff (j : Λ) (t : H) :
    t ∈ gradedPiece Λ π j ↔ gradingComponents Λ π t = Finsupp.single (Multiplicative.ofAdd j) t

name: Ihara.castHom_apply_one_zero
statement:
theorem castHom_apply_one_zero (hNM : N ∣ M) (g : Gamma0Fin N M) :
    ZMod.castHom hNM (ZMod N) ((g : SL(2, ZMod M)) 1 0) = 0

name: Ihara.gamma0FinMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gamma0FinMap_apply (hNM : N ∣ M) (g : Gamma0Fin N M) :
    gamma0FinMap N M hNM g = ZMod.castHom hNM (ZMod N) ((g : SL(2, ZMod M)) 1 1)

name: Ihara.gamma0FinUnitsChar_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gamma0FinUnitsChar_coe (hNM : N ∣ M) (g : Gamma0Fin N M) :

name: Ihara.mem_mennickeZ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_mennickeZ_iff (hmq : Nat.Coprime m q) (g : SL(2, ZAway q)) :
    g ∈ mennickeZ q m hmq ↔
      ∀ X ∈ principalCongruenceAway m q hmq, ⁅g, X⁆ ∈ mennickeQ q m

name: Ihara.mem_principalCongruenceAway_iff

theorem mem_principalCongruenceAway_iff (hNq : Nat.Coprime N q) {g : SL(2, ZAway q)} :
    g ∈ principalCongruenceAway N q hNq ↔ slAwayReduction N q hNq g = 1

name: Ihara.mennickeA_coe

name: Ihara.mennickeA_pow_coe

statement:
theorem mennickeCSP_iff_ker_le (hNq : Nat.Coprime N q) :

      principalCongruenceAway N q hNq ≤
        Subgroup.normalClosure ({(slToAway q mennickeA) ^ N} : Set SL(2, ZAway q))

name: Ihara.mennickeLemma21_iff
statement:
theorem mennickeLemma21_iff (hmq : Nat.Coprime m q) :

name: Ihara.mennickeQ_le_mennickeZ

name: Ihara.mennickeU_coe

name: Ihara.natCast_q_mul_qInv

name: Ihara.normalClosure_le_principalCongruenceAway

theorem normalClosure_le_principalCongruenceAway (hNq : Nat.Coprime N q) :

      principalCongruenceAway N q hNq

name: Ihara.qInv_mul_natCast_q
statement: theorem qInv_mul_natCast_q : qInv q * ((q : ℕ) : ZAway q) = 1

name: Ihara.slAwayReduction_coe

theorem slAwayReduction_coe (hNq : Nat.Coprime N q) (g : SL(2, ZAway q)) :
    ((slAwayReduction N q hNq g : SL(2, ZMod N)) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod N)) =
      (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZAway q)).map (zAwayToZMod N q hNq)

name: Ihara.slToAway_mennickeA_pow_mem

theorem map_wser (i : Fin g) (j : Fin e) :

name: IncidenceSystem.Data.map_xser

theorem map_xser (i : Fin g) :

name: IncidenceSystem.eval_branch
statement:
theorem eval_branch (i : Fin g) (j : Fin e) (r : Fin (m' + 1)) :
    MvPolynomial.eval pt (D.branch i j r) = (substAt pt i (D.G i j)).coeff r

name: IncidenceSystem.eval_inc
statement:
theorem eval_inc (i : Fin g) (r : Fin (m' + 1)) :
    MvPolynomial.eval pt (D.inc i r) =
      (substAt pt i (D.p none i) * spoly pt none i).coeff r +
        ∑ k : Fin (g * m'), pt (Var.c k) * (substAt pt i (D.p (some k) i) * spoly pt (some k) i).coeff r

name: IncidenceSystem.eval_inv
statement:
theorem eval_inv (k : Option (Fin (g * m'))) (i : Fin g) (r : Fin (m' + 1)) :
    MvPolynomial.eval pt (D.inv k i r) = (spoly pt k i * substAt pt i (D.s k i) - 1).coeff r

name: IncidenceSystem.eval_tc
statement:
theorem eval_tc (k : Option (Fin (g * m'))) (i : Fin g) (r : Fin (m' + 1)) :
    MvPolynomial.eval pt (D.tc k i r) = (substAt pt i (D.p k i) * spoly pt k i).coeff r

name: IncidenceSystem.map_eval_sser
statement:
theorem map_eval_sser (k : Option (Fin (g * m'))) (i : Fin g) :

name: IncidenceSystem.map_eval_subst
statement:
theorem map_eval_subst (i : Fin g) (H : MvPolynomial (Option (Fin e)) A) :
    (subst (m' := m') i H).map (MvPolynomial.eval pt) = substAt pt i H

name: IncidenceSystem.map_eval_wser
statement:
theorem map_eval_wser (i : Fin g) (j : Fin e) :
    (wser (m' := m') i j).map (MvPolynomial.eval pt) = wpoly pt i j

name: IncidenceSystem.map_eval_xser
statement:
theorem map_eval_xser (i : Fin g) :
    (xser (e := e) (m' := m') i).map (MvPolynomial.eval pt) = Polynomial.C (pt (Var.u i)) + Polynomial.X

name: IntMatrixOrder.Lm_eq_sum

name: IntMatrixOrder.Lm_single

name: IntMatrixOrder.crd_basisA

theorem elemM_map {R'' : Type*} [CommRing R''] (f : R' →+* R'') (a : Fin K → R') :

name: IntMatrixOrder.mul_elemM_mul_eq_of_single
statement:
theorem mul_elemM_mul_eq_of_single {m' : Type*} [Fintype m'] (β : Matrix m' (Fin n) R')
    (e : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R') (P : Matrix (Fin K) (Fin K) R' → Matrix m' (Fin n) R')
    (hP : ∀ κ, β * uC u R' κ * e = P (Lm c R' (Pi.single κ 1)))
    (hPadd : ∀ X Y, P (X + Y) = P X + P Y) (hPsmul : ∀ (z : R') X, P (z • X) = z • P X) (hP0 : P 0 = 0)

name: LanglandsTunnell.Lift48.K48_census
statement:
theorem K48_census :
    (K48.filter IsPM1).length = 2 ∧
    (K48.filter fun k => IsProjOrder 2 k ∧ det2 k = -1).length = 12 ∧
    (K48.filter fun k => IsProjOrder 2 k ∧ det2 k = 1).length = 6 ∧
    (K48.filter (IsProjOrder 3)).length = 16 ∧
    (K48.filter (IsProjOrder 4)).length = 12 ∧
    (K48.filter fun k => tr2 k = 0).length = 18 ∧ (K48.filter fun k => tr2 k = 1).length = 8 ∧
    (K48.filter fun k => tr2 k = -1).length = 8 ∧ (K48.filter fun k => tr2 k = ⟨0, 1⟩).length = 6 ∧
    (K48.filter fun k => tr2 k = ⟨0, -1⟩).length = 6 ∧ (K48.filter fun k => tr2 k = 2).length = 1 ∧
    (K48.filter fun k => tr2 k = -2).length = 1

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.ballIndicator_comp_mul_left
LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.ballIndicator_eq_sum_ballIndicator
statement:
theorem ballIndicator_eq_sum_ballIndicator (y : v.adicCompletion ℚ) {k m : ℤ} (hkm : k ≤ m)
    {X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hX : ∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hX' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m)) :
    ballIndicator v y k = ∑ r ∈ X, ballIndicator v (y + r) m

statement:
theorem exists_ball_data (φ : ↥(stepFunctions v)) :
    ∃ (k m : ℤ) (X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)), k ≤ m ∧
      (∀ x, (φ : v.adicCompletion ℚ → ℂ) x ≠ 0 → Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k)) ∧
      (∀ x y, Valued.v (x - y) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m) →
        (φ : v.adicCompletion ℚ → ℂ) x = (φ : v.adicCompletion ℚ → ℂ) y) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k)) ∧
      ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
        ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m)

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.exists_ball_representatives_add
statement:
theorem exists_ball_representatives_add {k n : ℤ} (hkn : k ≤ n) {X Y : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)}
    (hX : ∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hX' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-n))
    (hY : ∀ s ∈ Y, Valued.v s ≤ WithZero.exp (-n))
    (hY' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-n) →
      ∃! s, s ∈ Y ∧ Valued.v (x - s) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(n + 1))) :
    ∃ Z : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ), (∀ z ∈ Z, Valued.v z ≤ WithZero.exp (-k)) ∧
      (∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
        ∃! z, z ∈ Z ∧ Valued.v (x - z) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(n + 1))) ∧
      Z.card = X.card * Y.card ∧
      ∀ ψ : v.adicCompletion ℚ → ℂ, ∑ z ∈ Z, ψ z = ∑ r ∈ X, ∑ s ∈ Y, ψ (r + s)

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.exists_ball_representatives_of_valued_eq
statement:
theorem exists_ball_representatives_of_valued_eq {k m : ℤ} {X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)}
    (hX : ∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hX' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m))
    {t : v.adicCompletion ℚ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {a : ℤ} (hta : Valued.v t = WithZero.exp (-a))
    {k' m' : ℤ} (hk' : k' = k + a) (hm' : m' = m + a) :
    ∃ Y : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ), (∀ r ∈ Y, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k')) ∧
      (∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k') →
        ∃! r, r ∈ Y ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m')) ∧
      Y.card = X.card

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.exists_ball_representatives_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ball_representatives_zero (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ), (∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-(0 : ℤ))) ∧
      (∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-(0 : ℤ)) →
        ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(n : ℤ))) ∧
      X.card = Nat.card (𝓞 ℚ ⧸ v.asIdeal) ^ n

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.exists_ball_representatives_zero_one
statement:
theorem exists_ball_representatives_zero_one :
    ∃ X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ), (∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-(0 : ℤ))) ∧
      (∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-(0 : ℤ)) →
        ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(1 : ℤ))) ∧

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.exists_bijective_quotient_residueField

theorem exists_bijective_quotient_residueField :

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.exists_finset_ball_representatives
statement:
theorem exists_finset_ball_representatives (k m : ℤ) (hkm : k ≤ m) :

      (∀ x, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) → ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m)) ∧

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.inv_zpow_mul_sum_eq
statement:
theorem inv_zpow_mul_sum_eq {φ : v.adicCompletion ℚ → ℂ} {k m : ℤ} (hkm : k ≤ m)
    (hsupp : ∀ x, φ x ≠ 0 → Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hconst : ∀ x y, Valued.v (x - y) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m) → φ x = φ y)
    {X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hX : ∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hX' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m))
    {k' m' : ℤ} (hk'm' : k' ≤ m') (hsupp' : ∀ x, φ x ≠ 0 → Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k'))
    (hconst' : ∀ x y, Valued.v (x - y) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m') → φ x = φ y)
    {X' : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hY : ∀ r ∈ X', Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k'))
    (hY' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k') →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X' ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m')) :
    ((Nat.card (𝓞 ℚ ⧸ v.asIdeal) : ℂ) ^ m)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ X, φ r =
      ((Nat.card (𝓞 ℚ ⧸ v.asIdeal) : ℂ) ^ m')⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ X', φ r

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.inv_zpow_mul_sum_eq_of_eq_add_one
statement:
theorem inv_zpow_mul_sum_eq_of_eq_add_one {φ : v.adicCompletion ℚ → ℂ} {k m : ℤ} (hkm : k ≤ m)
    (hconst : ∀ x y, Valued.v (x - y) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m) → φ x = φ y)
    {X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hX : ∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hX' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m))
    {m₁ : ℤ} (hm₁ : m₁ = m + 1)
    {X₁ : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hX₁ : ∀ r ∈ X₁, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hX₁' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X₁ ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m₁)) :
    ((Nat.card (𝓞 ℚ ⧸ v.asIdeal) : ℂ) ^ m₁)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ X₁, φ r =
      ((Nat.card (𝓞 ℚ ⧸ v.asIdeal) : ℂ) ^ m)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ X, φ r

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.inv_zpow_mul_sum_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem inv_zpow_mul_sum_eq_of_le {φ : v.adicCompletion ℚ → ℂ} {k m : ℤ} (hkm : k ≤ m)
    (hconst : ∀ x y, Valued.v (x - y) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m) → φ x = φ y)
    {X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hX : ∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hX' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m)) (j : ℕ) {m' : ℤ} (hm' : m' = m + j)
    {X' : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hY : ∀ r ∈ X', Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hY' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X' ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m')) :
    ((Nat.card (𝓞 ℚ ⧸ v.asIdeal) : ℂ) ^ m')⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ X', φ r =
      ((Nat.card (𝓞 ℚ ⧸ v.asIdeal) : ℂ) ^ m)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ X, φ r

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.sum_eq_sum_of_ball_representatives
statement:
theorem sum_eq_sum_of_ball_representatives {φ : v.adicCompletion ℚ → ℂ} {k m : ℤ}
    (hconst : ∀ x y, Valued.v (x - y) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m) → φ x = φ y)
    {X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hX : ∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hX' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m))
    {X' : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hY : ∀ r ∈ X', Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hY' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X' ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m)) :
    ∑ r ∈ X, φ r = ∑ r ∈ X', φ r

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.sum_eq_sum_of_ball_representatives_of_le
statement:
theorem sum_eq_sum_of_ball_representatives_of_le {φ : v.adicCompletion ℚ → ℂ} {k k' m : ℤ}
    (hk'k : k' ≤ k) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hsupp : ∀ x, φ x ≠ 0 → Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hconst : ∀ x y, Valued.v (x - y) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m) → φ x = φ y)
    {X : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)} (hX : ∀ r ∈ X, Valued.v r ≤ WithZero.exp (-k))
    (hX' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k) →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m))
    {X' : Finset (v.adicCompletion ℚ)}
    (hY' : ∀ x : v.adicCompletion ℚ, Valued.v x ≤ WithZero.exp (-k') →
      ∃! r, r ∈ X' ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m)) :
    ∑ r ∈ X', φ r = ∑ r ∈ X, φ r

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.sum_ite_valued_sub_le
statement:

      ∃! r, r ∈ X ∧ Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m))

    (∑ r ∈ X, if Valued.v (x - r) ≤ WithZero.exp (-m) then c else 0) = c

statement:
theorem archDeriv_eq_fderiv {φ : AdelicGL 3 (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ → ℂ} (hφ : WhittakerBlock.IsArchSmooth3 φ) (i j : Fin 3)
    (g : AdelicGL 3 (𝓞 ℚ) ℚ) {e : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ} (he : (Matrix.of e).det ≠ 0) :
    archDeriv i j φ (g * WhittakerBlock.archRealLift3 e) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun e' => φ (g * WhittakerBlock.archRealLift3 e')) e (fun a b => if b = j then e a i else 0)

name: LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction.mem_congruenceK1_iff
statement:
theorem mem_congruenceK1_iff {c : ℕ} {k : GL (Fin 3) (v.adicCompletion K)} :

      k ∈ localMaximalCompact3 R K v ∧
      Valued.v ((k : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (v.adicCompletion K)) 2 0) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(c : ℤ)) ∧
      Valued.v ((k : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (v.adicCompletion K)) 2 1) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(c : ℤ)) ∧
      Valued.v ((k : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (v.adicCompletion K)) 2 2 - 1) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(c : ℤ))

statement:
theorem localEpsilonAt_def (μ : Measure (v.adicCompletion K)) (ψ : AddChar (v.adicCompletion K) ℂ)

name: ModularCurve.realizeOf_def
statement:
theorem realizeOf_def (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)) (x : LaurentSeries ℂ) (τ : ℍ) :
    realizeOf Γ x τ = by
      classical
      exact
        if H : ∃ p : (k : ℤ) × (ModularForm Γ k × ModularForm Γ k),
            (p.2.2 : ℍ → ℂ) τ ≠ 0 ∧
              x * ((qExpansion 1 (p.2.2 : ℍ → ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ) : LaurentSeries ℂ) =
                ((qExpansion 1 (p.2.1 : ℍ → ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ) : LaurentSeries ℂ)
        then (H.choose.2.1 : ℍ → ℂ) τ / (H.choose.2.2 : ℍ → ℂ) τ
        else 0

name: ModularCurve.realizeOf_gamma0
statement:
theorem realizeOf_gamma0 (N : ℕ) (x : LaurentSeries ℂ) (τ : ℍ) :
    realizeOf (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) x τ = realize N x τ

name: ModularCurve.realizeOf_of_not
statement:
theorem realizeOf_of_not (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)) (x : LaurentSeries ℂ) (τ : ℍ)
    (h : ¬ ∃ p : (k : ℤ) × (ModularForm Γ k × ModularForm Γ k),
        (p.2.2 : ℍ → ℂ) τ ≠ 0 ∧
          x * ((qExpansion 1 (p.2.2 : ℍ → ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ) : LaurentSeries ℂ) =
            ((qExpansion 1 (p.2.1 : ℍ → ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ) : LaurentSeries ℂ)) :
    realizeOf Γ x τ = 0

name: ModularCurve.componentGroupProj_heckeComponentAction
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentGroupProj_heckeComponentAction {e : ι → ℕ} {B : Matrix ι ι ℤ} {n : ℤ}
    (h : HeckeRowSums B n) (hsym : HeckeWeightSymm e B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℤ (characterLattice ι)) :
    heckeComponentAction e B h hsym (componentGroupProj e φ) =
      componentGroupProj e ((heckeCharacterAction B h).dualMap φ)

name: ModularCurve.degreeOn_heckeDivisorAction

theorem degreeOn_heckeDivisorAction {B : Matrix ι ι ℤ} {n : ℤ} (h : HeckeRowSums B n)

name: ModularCurve.gramMap_heckeCharacterAction

    (h : HeckeRowSums B n) (hsym : HeckeWeightSymm e B) (D : characterLattice ι) :
    gramMap e (heckeCharacterAction B h D) =
      (heckeCharacterAction B h).dualMap (gramMap e D)

name: ModularCurve.heckeDivisorAction_mem_characterLattice
ModularCurve.range_gramMap_le_comap_dualMap
statement:
theorem range_gramMap_le_comap_dualMap {e : ι → ℕ} {B : Matrix ι ι ℤ} {n : ℤ}
    (h : HeckeRowSums B n) (hsym : HeckeWeightSymm e B) :

    ∃ s : Finset L, ∀ (E : Type uE') [Field E] [Algebra ℚ E] (ι : E →+* L), (↑s ⊆ Set.range ι) →
      ∃ x : laurentBaseChange E F₀, laurentDescent ι F₀ x = y ∧
