theorem mem_annPart_iff (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] (θ : σ → K) (v : V) :
    v ∈ F.annPart p θ ↔ ∀ Q : MvPolynomial σ (ZMod p),
      MvPolynomial.aeval θ (MvPolynomial.map (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) K) Q) = 0 →
        F.eval (MvPolynomial.map (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) K) Q) v = 0

name: ModularCurve.mem_mTorsionDiffOf_iff
statement:
theorem mem_mTorsionDiffOf_iff (K : Type*) [Field K] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {σ : Type*} (F : Module.End.CommFamily K (LaurentSeries K) σ)
    (θbar : σ → K) (ω : Ω[↥(modularFunctionFieldC K N)⁄K]) :
    ω ∈ mTorsionDiffOf K p N F θbar ↔
      ω ∈ regularDifferentials K (modularFunctionFieldC K N) ∧
        ∀ Q : MvPolynomial σ (ZMod p),
          MvPolynomial.aeval θbar (MvPolynomial.map (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) K) Q) = 0 →
            F.eval (MvPolynomial.map (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) K) Q)
              (qExpansionDiffAlong (modularFunctionFieldC K N).val ω) = 0

name: ModularCurve.mem_mTorsionDiff_iff
statement:
theorem mem_mTorsionDiff_iff (K : Type*) [Field K] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {ι : Type*} (ℓ : ι → ℕ) (hℓ : ∀ i, 0 < ℓ i)
    (hcomm : ∀ a b : Option ι, Commute (qExpGens K p ℓ hℓ a) (qExpGens K p ℓ hℓ b))
    (θbar : Option ι → K) (ω : Ω[↥(modularFunctionFieldC K N)⁄K]) :
    ω ∈ mTorsionDiff K p N ℓ hℓ hcomm θbar ↔
      ω ∈ regularDifferentials K (modularFunctionFieldC K N) ∧
        ∀ Q : MvPolynomial (Option ι) (ZMod p),
          MvPolynomial.aeval θbar (MvPolynomial.map (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) K) Q) = 0 →
            (Module.End.CommFamily.mk (qExpGens K p ℓ hℓ) hcomm).eval
                (MvPolynomial.map (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) K) Q)
              (qExpansionDiffAlong (modularFunctionFieldC K N).val ω) = 0

name: ModularCurve.siegelFun_def
statement:
theorem siegelFun_def (N : ℕ) (r s : ℤ) (z : ℂ) :
    siegelFun N r s z =
      -Complex.exp (Real.pi * Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * ((r : ℂ) - (N : ℂ)) / (N : ℂ) ^ 2) *
        Complex.exp (Real.pi * Complex.I * (((r : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) ^ 2 - (r : ℂ) / (N : ℂ) + 1 / 6) * z) *
        (1 - Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((r : ℂ) * z + (s : ℂ)) / (N : ℂ))) *
        ∏' n : ℕ, ((1 - Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * z) ^ (n + 1) *
            Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((r : ℂ) * z + (s : ℂ)) / (N : ℂ))) *
          (1 - Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * z) ^ (n + 1) *
            (Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((r : ℂ) * z + (s : ℂ)) / (N : ℂ)))⁻¹))

name: MvFormalGroup.BigWittLaw.addFam_eq
statement:
theorem addFam_eq (n : ℕ) :
    addFam R n = MvPowerSeries.X (0, n) + MvPowerSeries.X (1, n) +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, MvPowerSeries.X (0, i) * MvPowerSeries.X (1, n - 1 - i)

name: MvFormalGroup.BigWittLaw.aeval_addPoly
statement:
theorem aeval_addPoly {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (g : Fin 2 × ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) :
    aeval g (addPoly n) = g (0, n) + g (1, n) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g (0, i) * g (1, n - 1 - i)

name: MvFormalGroup.BigWittLaw.coeff_succ_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_succ_mul {A : Type*} [CommRing A] {F G : PowerSeries A}
    (hF : PowerSeries.constantCoeff F = 1) (hG : PowerSeries.constantCoeff G = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) (F * G) =
      PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) F + PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) G +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, PowerSeries.coeff (i + 1) F * PowerSeries.coeff (n - 1 - i + 1) G

name: MvFormalGroup.BigWittLaw.coeff_succ_mul_eq_aeval
statement:
theorem coeff_succ_mul_eq_aeval {A : Type*} [CommRing A] {F G : PowerSeries A}
    (hF : PowerSeries.constantCoeff F = 1) (hG : PowerSeries.constantCoeff G = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) (F * G) =
      aeval (fun im : Fin 2 × ℕ =>
        (![fun m => PowerSeries.coeff (m + 1) F, fun m => PowerSeries.coeff (m + 1) G] :
          Fin 2 → ℕ → A) im.1 im.2) (addPoly n)

name: MvFormalGroup.BigWittLaw.subst_addFam
statement:
theorem subst_addFam {τ : Type*} {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    {u : Fin 2 × ℕ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (hu : MvPowerSeries.HasSubst u) (n : ℕ) :
    MvPowerSeries.subst u (addFam R n) =
      u (0, n) + u (1, n) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, u (0, i) * u (1, n - 1 - i)

name: MvFormalGroup.BigWittLaw.subst_coe_addFam
statement:
theorem subst_coe_addFam {τ : Type*} (g : Fin 2 × ℕ → MvPolynomial τ ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    MvPowerSeries.subst (fun im => ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom R) (g im) : MvPolynomial τ R) :
      MvPowerSeries τ R)) (addFam R n) =
      ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom R) (aeval g (addPoly n)) : MvPolynomial τ R) :
        MvPowerSeries τ R)

name: NumberField.LevelArith.div_kummerRoot_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem div_kummerRoot_pow_eq_one (x : (↥F)ˣ) (σ : ↥F.fixingSubgroup) :
    ((σ : AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (kummerRoot p F x) / kummerRoot p F x) ^ p = 1

name: NumberField.LevelArith.exists_kummerExp
statement:
theorem exists_kummerExp (x : (↥F)ˣ) (σ : ↥F.fixingSubgroup) :
    ∃ i < p, ζ ^ i = (σ : AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (kummerRoot p F x) / kummerRoot p F x

name: NumberField.LevelArith.kummerChar_spec
statement:
theorem kummerChar_spec (x : (↥F)ˣ) (σ : ↥F.fixingSubgroup) :
    (σ : AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ) (kummerRoot p F x) = ζ ^ (kummerChar p ζ hζ F x σ).val * kummerRoot p F x

name: NumberField.LevelArith.kummerRoot_ne_zero
statement: theorem kummerRoot_ne_zero (x : (↥F)ˣ) : kummerRoot p F x ≠ 0

name: NumberField.LevelArith.kummerRoot_pow

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.absNorm_mem

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.chiIdeal_chi
statement:
theorem chiIdeal_chi (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    M4aP2.chiIdeal K (fm K m) (chi K m ψ) (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) =
      ψ (Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal : ZMod m)

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.chiIdeal_chi_span
statement:
theorem chiIdeal_chi_span (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) {α : 𝓞 K} (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (h1 : α - 1 ∈ fm K m) :
    M4aP2.chiIdeal K (fm K m) (chi K m ψ) ((Ideal.span {α} : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) =
      ψ ((SignType.sign (Algebra.norm ℤ α) : ℤ) : ZMod m)

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.chiIdeal_prime
statement:
theorem chiIdeal_prime {𝔣 : Ideal (𝓞 K)} (χ : NarrowRayClassGroup K 𝔣 →* ℂ)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    M4aP2.chiIdeal K 𝔣 χ (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) =
      if hv : v.asIdeal ∣ 𝔣 then 0 else χ (primeClass K 𝔣 v hv)

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.chi_apply
statement:
theorem chi_apply (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (g : NarrowRayClassGroup K (fm K m)) :
    chi K m ψ g = ψ ((nu K m g : (ZMod m)ˣ) : ZMod m)

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.chi_mul
statement: theorem chi_mul (ψ θ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) : chi K m (ψ * θ) = chi K m ψ * chi K m θ

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.chi_one
statement: theorem chi_one : chi K m 1 = 1

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.chi_primeClass

theorem chi_primeClass (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K))
    (hv : ¬ v.asIdeal ∣ fm K m) :
    chi K m ψ (primeClass K (fm K m) v hv) = ψ (Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal : ZMod m)

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.coprime_of_not_mem

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.fm_ne_bot

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.ncard_fibre_eq

theorem ncard_fibre_eq (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    {w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L) | w.under (𝓞 K) = v}.ncard = (v.asIdeal.primesOver (𝓞 L)).ncard

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.ncard_fibre_le
statement:
theorem ncard_fibre_le (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    {w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L) | w.under (𝓞 K) = v}.ncard ≤ Module.finrank K L

name: NumberField.NormResidueChar.ncard_primesOver_le
statement:
theorem ncard_primesOver_le (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.coe_transportIntegers

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.continuous_transport

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.intValuation_smul_apply

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.inv_smul_eq_of_smul_eq

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.mem_smul_asIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_smul_asIdeal_iff (σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) (x : 𝓞 K) :
    x ∈ (σ • w).asIdeal ↔ σ⁻¹ • x ∈ w.asIdeal

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.smul_asIdeal
statement:
theorem smul_asIdeal (σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    (σ • w).asIdeal = w.asIdeal.comap (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv (K ≃ₐ[E] K) (𝓞 K) σ⁻¹ : 𝓞 K →+* 𝓞 K)

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.smul_asIdeal_eq_map
statement:
theorem smul_asIdeal_eq_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    (σ • w).asIdeal = Ideal.map ((MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv (K ≃ₐ[E] K) (𝓞 K) σ : 𝓞 K ≃+* 𝓞 K) : 𝓞 K →+* 𝓞 K) w.asIdeal

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.smul_mem_smul_asIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem smul_mem_smul_asIdeal_iff (σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) (x : 𝓞 K) :

statement:
theorem smul_mem_smul_asIdeal_pow_iff (σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) (x : 𝓞 K) (n : ℕ) :

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.transport_apply
statement:
theorem transport_apply (σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) {w w' : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)} (h : σ • w = w') (x : w.adicCompletion K) :
    (transport σ h x).toCompletion
      = UniformSpace.Completion.map (WithVal.congr (w.valuation K) (w'.valuation K) ((σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) : K ≃+* K)) x.toCompletion

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.transport_coe
statement:
theorem transport_coe (σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) {w w' : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)} (h : σ • w = w') (x : WithVal (w.valuation K)) :
    transport σ h (x : w.adicCompletion K)
      = ((WithVal.congr (w.valuation K) (w'.valuation K) ((σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) : K ≃+* K) x : WithVal (w'.valuation K)) : w'.adicCompletion K)

name: NumberField.PlaceTransport.transport_mem_adicCompletionIntegers_iff
statement:
theorem transport_mem_adicCompletionIntegers_iff (σ : K ≃ₐ[E] K) {w w' : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)} (h : σ • w = w')
    (x : w.adicCompletion K) : transport σ h x ∈ w'.adicCompletionIntegers K ↔ x ∈ w.adicCompletionIntegers K

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.cast_sigma_three
statement:
theorem cast_sigma_three (N : ℕ) :

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.cast_sigma_two

theorem cast_sigma_two (N : ℕ) :

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.engine_a2
statement:
theorem engine_a2 (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), (x.1 * x.1 : ℤ))
        + ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), (x.2.2.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)
      = (∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), (x.1 * x.1 : ℤ))
        + 2 * ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.engine_ac

theorem engine_ac (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)
      = (∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ))
        + ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), (x.2.2.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.engine_c2
statement:
theorem engine_c2 (N : ℕ) :

      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), (x.2.2.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.filter_diag_comm
statement:
theorem filter_diag_comm (N : ℕ) :
    (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 = x.1) = (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.six_mul_sum_Ico_mul_rev
statement:
theorem six_mul_sum_Ico_mul_rev (M : ℕ) :
    6 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M, ((b : ℤ) * (M - b)) = M * M * M - M

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.six_mul_sum_Ico_sq
statement:
theorem six_mul_sum_Ico_sq (M : ℕ) :
    6 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M, ((b : ℤ) * b) = 2 * M * M * M - 3 * M * M + M

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.slice_a2_eq_slice_ac
statement:
theorem slice_a2_eq_slice_ac (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), (x.1 * x.1 : ℤ)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.slice_ac
statement:
theorem slice_ac (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)
      = N * sigma 1 N - sigma 2 N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.slice_b2
statement:
theorem slice_b2 (N : ℕ) :
    6 * ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), (x.2.1 * x.2.1 : ℤ)
      = 2 * sigma 3 N - 3 * sigma 2 N + sigma 1 N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.slice_bd
statement:
theorem slice_bd (N : ℕ) :
    6 * ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), (x.2.1 * x.2.2.2 : ℤ)
      = sigma 3 N - sigma 1 N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.sum_ac_eq_sigmaConv
statement:
theorem sum_ac_eq_sigmaConv (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ Sols N, (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ) = (sigmaConv 1 1 N : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.sum_slice_diag
statement:
theorem sum_slice_diag {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (N : ℕ) (F : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → β) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), F x
      = ∑ p ∈ N.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ b ∈ Finset.Ico 1 p.2, F (p.1, b, p.1, p.2 - b)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.sum_split
statement:
theorem sum_split {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (N : ℕ) (F : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → M)
    (g h : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ Sols N, F x
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => g x < h x), F x
        + ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => h x = g x), F x
        + ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => h x < g x), F x

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.swap1_ac_a
statement:
theorem swap1_ac_a (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 < x.2.2.1), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.swap1_ac_d
statement:
theorem swap1_ac_d (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.2 < x.2.1), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.swap1_c2_a
statement:
theorem swap1_c2_a (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), (x.2.2.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 < x.2.2.1), (x.1 * x.1 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.swap1_c2_d
statement:
theorem swap1_c2_d (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), (x.2.2.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.2 < x.2.1), (x.1 * x.1 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.swap2_a2_diag
statement:
theorem swap2_a2_diag (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.2 = x.2.1), (x.1 * x.1 : ℤ)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), (x.2.1 * x.2.1 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.swap2_ac_diag
statement:
theorem swap2_ac_diag (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.2 = x.2.1), (x.1 * x.2.2.1 : ℤ)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), (x.2.1 * x.2.2.2 : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.BesgeCertificate.two_mul_sum_Ico_id
statement:
theorem two_mul_sum_Ico_id (M : ℕ) :
    2 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M, (b : ℤ) = M * M - M

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.cast_sigma_five
statement:
theorem cast_sigma_five (N : ℕ) :
    ((sigma 5 N : ℕ) : ℤ) = ∑ d ∈ N.divisors, (d : ℤ) ^ 5

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.cast_sigma_four
statement:
theorem cast_sigma_four (N : ℕ) :
    ((sigma 4 N : ℕ) : ℤ) = ∑ d ∈ N.divisors, (d : ℤ) ^ 4

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.cast_sigma_three_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem cast_sigma_three_antidiagonal (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (p.1 : ℤ) ^ 3 = (sigma 3 n : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.engine_ac3
statement:
theorem engine_ac3 (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) * (x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 3)
      = (∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), ((x.1 : ℤ) * (x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 3))
        + ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), ((x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 4)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.engine_c4
statement:
theorem engine_c4 (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), ((x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 4)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), ((x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 4)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.four_mul_sum_Ico_cube
statement:
theorem four_mul_sum_Ico_cube (M : ℕ) :
    4 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M, (b : ℤ) ^ 3 = M ^ 4 - 2 * M ^ 3 + M ^ 2

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.sixty_mul_sum_Ico_mul_cube_rev
statement:
theorem sixty_mul_sum_Ico_mul_cube_rev (M : ℕ) :
    60 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M, ((b : ℤ) * ((M : ℤ) - b) ^ 3)
      = 3 * M ^ 5 - 5 * M ^ 3 + 2 * M

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.slice_a2c2_eq_slice_a4
statement:
theorem slice_a2c2_eq_slice_a4 (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) ^ 2 * (x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 2)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) ^ 4)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.slice_a4
statement:
theorem slice_a4 (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) ^ 4)
      = N * sigma 3 N - sigma 4 N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.slice_ac3_eq_slice_a4
statement:
theorem slice_ac3_eq_slice_a4 (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) * (x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 3)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) ^ 4)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.slice_b2d2
statement:
theorem slice_b2d2 (N : ℕ) :
    30 * ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), ((x.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 2 * (x.2.2.2 : ℤ) ^ 2)
      = sigma 5 N - sigma 1 N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.slice_b4
statement:
theorem slice_b4 (N : ℕ) :
    30 * ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), ((x.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 4)
      = 6 * sigma 5 N - 15 * sigma 4 N + 10 * sigma 3 N - sigma 1 N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.slice_bd3
statement:
theorem slice_bd3 (N : ℕ) :
    60 * ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 = x.2.2.1), ((x.2.1 : ℤ) * (x.2.2.2 : ℤ) ^ 3)
      = 3 * sigma 5 N - 5 * sigma 3 N + 2 * sigma 1 N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.sum_ac3_eq_sigmaConv
statement:
theorem sum_ac3_eq_sigmaConv (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ Sols N, ((x.1 : ℤ) * (x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 3) = (sigmaConv 1 3 N : ℤ)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.swap1_a2c2_lt_a
statement:
theorem swap1_a2c2_lt_a (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 < x.2.2.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) ^ 2 * (x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 2)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) ^ 2 * (x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 2)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.swap1_a4_lt_a
statement:
theorem swap1_a4_lt_a (N : ℕ) :

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.swap1_a4_lt_d
statement:
theorem swap1_a4_lt_d (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.2 < x.2.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) ^ 4)
      = ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), ((x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 4)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.swap1_ac3_lt_a
statement:
theorem swap1_ac3_lt_a (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.1 < x.2.2.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) * (x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 3)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.swap1_ac3_lt_d
statement:
theorem swap1_ac3_lt_d (N : ℕ) :

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.swap2_a2c2_diag
statement:
theorem swap2_a2c2_diag (N : ℕ) :

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.swap2_a4_diag
statement:
theorem swap2_a4_diag (N : ℕ) :

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.swap2_ac3_diag
statement:
theorem swap2_ac3_diag (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.2 = x.2.1), ((x.1 : ℤ) * (x.2.2.1 : ℤ) ^ 3)

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.thirty_mul_sum_Ico_pow_four
statement:
theorem thirty_mul_sum_Ico_pow_four (M : ℕ) :
    30 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M, (b : ℤ) ^ 4
      = 6 * M ^ 5 - 15 * M ^ 4 + 10 * M ^ 3 - M

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.thirty_mul_sum_Ico_sq_mul_sq_rev
statement:
theorem thirty_mul_sum_Ico_sq_mul_sq_rev (M : ℕ) :
    30 * ∑ b ∈ Finset.Ico 1 M, ((b : ℤ) ^ 2 * ((M : ℤ) - b) ^ 2)
      = M ^ 5 - M

statement: theorem weight6Identity (N : ℕ) : Weight6Identity N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.Weight6Certificate.weight6Identity_int
statement:
theorem weight6Identity_int (N : ℕ) :
    (240 * sigmaConv 1 3 N : ℤ)
      = 21 * sigma 5 N + (10 - 30 * N) * sigma 3 N - sigma 1 N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.besgeIdentity_iff_int
statement:
theorem besgeIdentity_iff_int (N : ℕ) :
    BesgeIdentity N ↔
      (12 * sigmaConv 1 1 N : ℤ) = 5 * sigma 3 N + (1 - 6 * N) * sigma 1 N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.besgeIdentity_of_le_six
statement: theorem besgeIdentity_of_le_six {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≤ 6) : BesgeIdentity N

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.euclidStepInv_mem
statement:
theorem euclidStepInv_mem {N : ℕ} {y : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ}
    (hy : y ∈ (Sols N).filter fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2) :
    euclidStepInv y ∈ ((Sols N).filter fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1) ∧
      euclidStep (euclidStepInv y) = y

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.euclidStep_injOn
statement:
theorem euclidStep_injOn (N : ℕ) :
    ∀ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1),
      ∀ y ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), euclidStep x = euclidStep y → x = y

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.euclidStep_mem
FLT.DivisorConvolution.image_euclidStep
statement:
theorem image_euclidStep (N : ℕ) :

      = (Sols N).filter fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2

statement: @[simp] theorem sigmaConv_one (k l : ℕ) : sigmaConv k l 1 = 0

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.sum_ac_filter_lt
statement:
theorem sum_ac_filter_lt (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), x.1 * x.2.2.1
      = (∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), x.1 * x.2.2.1)
        + ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), x.2.2.1 * x.2.2.1

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.sum_euclidStep
statement:
theorem sum_euclidStep {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (N : ℕ) (F : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → M) :
    ∑ x ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.2.1 < x.1), F (euclidStep x)
      = ∑ y ∈ (Sols N).filter (fun x => x.2.1 < x.2.2.2), F y

name: FLT.DivisorConvolution.weight6Identity_iff_int
statement:
theorem weight6Identity_iff_int (N : ℕ) :

name: PadicInt.KummerCarrier.cfac_pow_p_mul
statement:
lemma cfac_pow_p_mul (a b : ZMod p) :
    cfac p u a b ^ p * (u : ℤ_[p]) ^ (a.val + b.val) = (u : ℤ_[p]) ^ (a + b).val

name: PadicInt.KummerCarrier.evalAt_eq_aeval_polyLift
statement:
lemma evalAt_eq_aeval_polyLift (j : ZMod p) (w : L)
    (hw : w ^ p = algebraMap ℤ_[p] L ((u : ℤ_[p]) ^ j.val)) (h : Carrier p u) :
    evalAt p u j w hw h = Polynomial.aeval w (polyLift p u h j)

name: PadicInt.KummerCarrier.kpoly_monic
statement: lemma kpoly_monic (j : ZMod p) : (kpoly p u j).Monic

name: PadicInt.KummerCarrier.piPiEquiv_tmul
statement:
lemma piPiEquiv_tmul (f g : Carrier p u) (a b : ZMod p) :
    piPiEquiv p u (f ⊗ₜ g) a b = f a ⊗ₜ g b

name: PadicInt.KummerCarrier.z_pow_p
statement:
lemma z_pow_p (j : ZMod p) :
    z p u j ^ p = algebraMap ℤ_[p] (A p u j) ((u : ℤ_[p]) ^ j.val)

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.add_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma add_app {X : Cᵒᵖ} (φ ψ : naturalFamilies F N X) {Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (x : F.obj Y) : (φ + ψ).1 f x = φ.1 f x + ψ.1 f x

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.congr_app
statement:
lemma congr_app {X : Cᵒᵖ} (φ : naturalFamilies F N X) {Y : Cᵒᵖ} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g)
    (x : F.obj Y) : φ.1 f x = φ.1 g x

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.curryFamily_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma curryFamily_app (θ : F ⊗ G ⟶ N) {X : Cᵒᵖ} (y : G.obj X) {Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (x : F.obj Y) : (curryFamily F θ y).1 f x = θ.app Y (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj Y] G.map f y)

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.map_id_apply
statement:
lemma map_id_apply (M : PresheafOfModules.{u} (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)) (X : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.obj X) :
    M.map (𝟙 X) x = x

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.naturalFamilies_ext
statement:
@[ext] lemma naturalFamilies_ext {X : Cᵒᵖ} {φ ψ : naturalFamilies F N X}
    (h : ∀ ⦃Y : Cᵒᵖ⦄ (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : F.obj Y), φ.1 f x = ψ.1 f x) : φ = ψ

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.naturality
statement:
lemma naturality {X : Cᵒᵖ} (φ : naturalFamilies F N X) ⦃Y Z : Cᵒᵖ⦄ (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (x : F.obj Y) : N.map g (φ.1 f x) = φ.1 (f ≫ g) (F.map g x)

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.neg_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_app {X : Cᵒᵖ} (φ : naturalFamilies F N X) {Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (x : F.obj Y) : (-φ).1 f x = - φ.1 f x

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.postcomp_app
PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.presheaf_map_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma presheaf_map_apply {X X' : Cᵒᵖ} (h : X ⟶ X') (φ : naturalFamilies F N X) {Y : Cᵒᵖ}
    (f : X' ⟶ Y) (x : F.obj Y) : ((presheaf F N).map h φ).1 f x = φ.1 (h ≫ f) x

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.restrict_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma restrict_app {X X' : Cᵒᵖ} (h : X ⟶ X') (φ : naturalFamilies F N X) {Y : Cᵒᵖ}
    (f : X' ⟶ Y) (x : F.obj Y) : (restrict F N h φ).1 f x = φ.1 (h ≫ f) x

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.smul_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma smul_app {X : Cᵒᵖ} (r : R.obj X) (φ : naturalFamilies F N X) {Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y)

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.sub_app

name: PresheafOfModules.InternalHom.zero_app

name: PresheafOfModules.curry'_app_val

name: PresheafOfModules.curry'_uncurry'

PresheafOfModules.tensorObj_map_tmul'
statement:
lemma tensorObj_map_tmul' {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} (g : X ⟶ Y) (x : F.obj X) (y : G.obj X) :
    DFunLike.coe (α := (F.obj X ⊗ G.obj X :))
      (β := fun _ => (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (R.map g).hom).obj (F.obj Y ⊗ G.obj Y))
      (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (R := ↑(R.obj X)) ((F ⊗ G).map g)) (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj X] y) =
    F.map g x ⊗ₜ[R.obj Y] G.map g y

name: PresheafOfModules.uncurry'_app_tmul
statement:
lemma uncurry'_app_tmul (κ : G ⟶ ihomObj F N) {X : Cᵒᵖ} (x : F.obj X) (y : G.obj X) :
    DFunLike.coe (α := (F.obj X ⊗ G.obj X :)) (β := fun _ => N.obj X)
      ((uncurry' F κ).app X).hom (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj X] y) = (κ.app X y).1 (𝟙 X) x

name: PresheafOfModules.uncurry'_curry'

name: PresheafOfModules.uncurryApp_tmul
statement:
lemma uncurryApp_tmul (κ : G ⟶ ihomObj F N) (X : Cᵒᵖ) (x : F.obj X) (y : G.obj X) :
    DFunLike.coe (α := (F.obj X ⊗ G.obj X :)) (β := fun _ => N.obj X)
      (uncurryApp F κ X).hom (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj X] y) = (κ.app X y).1 (𝟙 X) x

name: PresheafOfModules.PullbackMonoidal.keyL
statement:
lemma keyL (U V : C) :
    ((j (S := S) U V).inv ≫ ((u₂ F φ U ⊗ₘ u₂ F φ V) ≫
      μ (pf F φ) (gR (F.obj U)) (gR (F.obj V)))).app (op (U ⨯ V)) (ModuleCat.freeMk (𝟙 (U ⨯ V))) =
    (ModuleCat.freeMk (F.map prod.fst) ⊗ₜ[R.obj (op (F.obj (U ⨯ V)))]
      ModuleCat.freeMk (F.map prod.snd) :
      ((gR (R := R) (F.obj U)).obj (op (F.obj (U ⨯ V))) ⊗
        (gR (R := R) (F.obj V)).obj (op (F.obj (U ⨯ V))) :))

      (ModuleCat.freeMk (𝟙 (U ⨯ V))) =
    (ModuleCat.freeMk (F.map prod.fst) ⊗ₜ[R.obj (op (F.obj (U ⨯ V)))]
      ModuleCat.freeMk (F.map prod.snd) :
      ((gR (R := R) (F.obj U)).obj (op (F.obj (U ⨯ V))) ⊗
        (gR (R := R) (F.obj V)).obj (op (F.obj (U ⨯ V))) :))

theorem nnnorm_term_sub_term_succ_le (hq₁ : ‖q₁‖₊ < 1) (hq₂ : ‖q₂‖₊ < 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖term c q₁ (m + 1) - term c q₂ (m + 1)‖₊
      ≤ (max ‖q₁‖₊ ‖q₂‖₊) ^ m * ‖q₁ - q₂‖₊

    (hq₁ : ‖q₁‖₊ < 1) (hq₂ : ‖q₂‖₊ < 1)
    (h₁ : (curve q₁).c₄ ^ 3 = j₀ * (curve q₁).Δ)
    (h₂ : (curve q₂).c₄ ^ 3 = j₀ * (curve q₂).Δ) : q₁ = q₂

name: TateCurve.term_sub_term
statement:
theorem term_sub_term (hq₁ : ‖q₁‖₊ < 1) (hq₂ : ‖q₂‖₊ < 1) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    term c q₁ n - term c q₂ n
      = (c n : K) * ((q₁ ^ n - q₂ ^ n) / ((1 - q₁ ^ n) * (1 - q₂ ^ n)))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_add_addX_negY_mul_sq
statement:
theorem addX_add_addX_negY_mul_sq {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : F} (h₁ : W.Equation x₁ y₁)
    (h₂ : W.Equation x₂ y₂) (hx : x₁ ≠ x₂) :
    (W.addX x₁ x₂ (W.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂) +
        W.addX x₁ x₂ (W.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ (W.negY x₂ y₂))) * (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 =
      2 * (x₁ * x₂) * (x₁ + x₂) + W.b₂ * (x₁ * x₂) + W.b₄ * (x₁ + x₂) + W.b₆

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_mul_addX_negY_mul_sq
statement:
theorem addX_mul_addX_negY_mul_sq {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : F} (h₁ : W.Equation x₁ y₁)
    (h₂ : W.Equation x₂ y₂) (hx : x₁ ≠ x₂) :
    W.addX x₁ x₂ (W.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂) *
        W.addX x₁ x₂ (W.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ (W.negY x₂ y₂)) * (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 =
      (x₁ * x₂) ^ 2 - W.b₄ * (x₁ * x₂) - W.b₆ * (x₁ + x₂) - W.b₈

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_mul_sq_of_X_ne
statement:
lemma addX_mul_sq_of_X_ne {x₁ x₂ : F} (y₁ y₂ : F) (hx : x₁ ≠ x₂) :
    W.addX x₁ x₂ (W.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂) * (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 =
      (y₁ - y₂) ^ 2 + W.a₁ * (y₁ - y₂) * (x₁ - x₂) - (W.a₂ + x₁ + x₂) * (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_self_mul_sq_of_Y_ne
statement:
lemma addX_self_mul_sq_of_Y_ne {x₁ y₁ : F} (hy : y₁ ≠ W.negY x₁ y₁) :
    W.addX x₁ x₁ (W.slope x₁ x₁ y₁ y₁) * (y₁ - W.negY x₁ y₁) ^ 2 =
      (3 * x₁ ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x₁ + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y₁) ^ 2 +
        W.a₁ * (3 * x₁ ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x₁ + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y₁) * (y₁ - W.negY x₁ y₁) -
        (W.a₂ + x₁ + x₁) * (y₁ - W.negY x₁ y₁) ^ 2

statement:

name: WeierstrassCurve.velu2QuadDisc_eq_disc_cofactor
statement:

    W.velu2QuadDisc x₀
      = (W.b₂ + 4 * x₀) ^ 2 - 16 * (4 * x₀ ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x₀ + 2 * W.b₄)

name: WeierstrassCurve.velu2XNum_eq_mul
statement:
lemma velu2XNum_eq_mul (x : R) :

name: WeierstrassCurve.velu2Y_eq_div
statement:
lemma velu2Y_eq_div (x₀ y₀ : F) {x : F} (y : F) (hx : x ≠ x₀) :
    W.velu2Y x₀ y₀ x y = W.velu2YNum x₀ y₀ x y / (x - x₀) ^ 3

name: WeierstrassCurve.velu2_equation_cleared_four
statement:
theorem velu2_equation_cleared_four {x₀ y₀ x y : R}
    (hP : W.toAffine.Equation x y) (hQ : W.toAffine.Equation x₀ y₀)
    (hgy : W.veluGy x₀ y₀ = 0) :
    4 * (W.velu2YNum x₀ y₀ x y ^ 2
        + W.a₁ * W.velu2XNum x₀ y₀ x * W.velu2YNum x₀ y₀ x y * (x - x₀)
        + W.a₃ * W.velu2YNum x₀ y₀ x y * (x - x₀) ^ 3)
      = 4 * (W.velu2XNum x₀ y₀ x ^ 3 + W.a₂ * W.velu2XNum x₀ y₀ x ^ 2 * (x - x₀) ^ 2
        + (W.a₄ - 5 * W.veluGx x₀ y₀) * W.velu2XNum x₀ y₀ x * (x - x₀) ^ 4
        + (W.a₆ - W.b₂ * W.veluGx x₀ y₀ - 7 * (x₀ * W.veluGx x₀ y₀)) * (x - x₀) ^ 6)

lemma addX_slope_pow [DecidableEq k] (hφ : ∀ a : k, φ a = a ^ q) (hfix : V.map φ = V)
    (x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : k) :
    V.toAffine.addX (x₁ ^ q) (x₂ ^ q) (V.toAffine.slope (x₁ ^ q) (x₂ ^ q) (y₁ ^ q) (y₂ ^ q))

    V.toAffine.addY (x₁ ^ q) (x₂ ^ q) (y₁ ^ q)
        (V.toAffine.slope (x₁ ^ q) (x₂ ^ q) (y₁ ^ q) (y₂ ^ q))
      = V.toAffine.addY x₁ x₂ y₁ (V.toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂) ^ q

      = frobPoint (Fintype.card F) (fun {_ _} h => nonsingular_pow_card_map f h) P
        + frobPoint (Fintype.card F) (fun {_ _} h => nonsingular_pow_card_map f h) Q

        (x * W.veluGx x (W.toAffine.negY x y) -
          W.toAffine.negY x y * W.veluGy x (W.toAffine.negY x y)) =

name: WeierstrassCurve.oddOrderSummingSet_two_mul
statement:
theorem oddOrderSummingSet_two_mul {F : Type*} [Field F] [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F)
    (Q : W.toAffine.Point) (n : ℕ) (hQ : addOrderOf Q = 2 * n + 1) :
    W.oddOrderSummingSet Q (2 * n) =
      W.oddOrderSummingSet Q n ∪
        (W.oddOrderSummingSet Q n).image (fun P => (P.1, W.toAffine.negY P.1 P.2))

name: WeierstrassCurve.sum_asymWeight_oddOrderSummingSet_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_asymWeight_oddOrderSummingSet_two_mul {F : Type*} [Field F] [DecidableEq F]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve F) (Q : W.toAffine.Point) (n : ℕ) (hQ : addOrderOf Q = 2 * n + 1) :
    ∑ P ∈ W.oddOrderSummingSet Q (2 * n), (P.1 * W.veluGx P.1 P.2 - P.2 * W.veluGy P.1 P.2) =
      W.veluWSum (W.oddOrderSummingSet Q n)

name: WeierstrassCurve.sum_oddOrderSummingSet_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_oddOrderSummingSet_two_mul {F : Type*} [Field F] [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F)
    (Q : W.toAffine.Point) (n : ℕ) (hQ : addOrderOf Q = 2 * n + 1) (f : F × F → F) :
    ∑ P ∈ W.oddOrderSummingSet Q (2 * n), f P =
      ∑ P ∈ W.oddOrderSummingSet Q n, (f P + f (P.1, W.toAffine.negY P.1 P.2))

name: WeierstrassCurve.sum_veluGx_oddOrderSummingSet_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_veluGx_oddOrderSummingSet_two_mul {F : Type*} [Field F] [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F)
    (Q : W.toAffine.Point) (n : ℕ) (hQ : addOrderOf Q = 2 * n + 1) :
    ∑ P ∈ W.oddOrderSummingSet Q (2 * n), W.veluGx P.1 P.2 = W.veluTSum (W.oddOrderSummingSet Q n)

      - (W.a₂ + 3 * x) * W.deuringA₃ x y ^ 2

name: WeierstrassCurve.flexForm_deuringCurve
statement:
theorem flexForm_deuringCurve (τ ν η : F) :
    (deuringCurve τ ν).flexForm ν η =
      -(τ ^ 2 + 12 * ν) * (deuringCurve τ ν).toAffine.polynomial.evalEval ν η
        - ν ^ 3 * (3 * ν + τ ^ 2 + 3 * τ + 3)

      = (C.u : R) ^ 8 * (C • W).flexForm x y

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeAbscissa_def
statement:
theorem levelThreeAbscissa_def (x₁ y₁ x₂ : R) : W.levelThreeAbscissa x₁ y₁ x₂ =
    (x₂ - x₁) ^ 3 * Ring.inverse (W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁) ^ 2

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeAbscissa_deuringCurve
statement:
theorem levelThreeAbscissa_deuringCurve {τ ν : F} (hν : ν ≠ 0) :
    (deuringCurve τ ν).levelThreeAbscissa 0 0 ν = ν

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeAbscissa_eq_div
statement:
theorem levelThreeAbscissa_eq_div (x₁ y₁ x₂ : F) :
    W.levelThreeAbscissa x₁ y₁ x₂ = (x₂ - x₁) ^ 3 / W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁ ^ 2

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeAbscissa_map
statement:
theorem levelThreeAbscissa_map (x₁ y₁ x₂ : F) :
    (W.map φ).levelThreeAbscissa (φ x₁) (φ y₁) (φ x₂) = φ (W.levelThreeAbscissa x₁ y₁ x₂)

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeAbscissa_map_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem levelThreeAbscissa_map_of_isUnit {x₁ y₁ : R} (h : IsUnit (W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁)) (x₂ : R) :
    (W.map f).levelThreeAbscissa (f x₁) (f y₁) (f x₂) = f (W.levelThreeAbscissa x₁ y₁ x₂)

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeAbscissa_variableChange
statement:
theorem levelThreeAbscissa_variableChange (C : VariableChange F) (x₁ y₁ x₂ : F) :
    W.levelThreeAbscissa ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r) ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₂ + C.r)
      = (C • W).levelThreeAbscissa x₁ y₁ x₂

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeModulus_def
statement:
theorem levelThreeModulus_def (x₁ y₁ x₂ : R) : W.levelThreeModulus x₁ y₁ x₂ =
    W.deuringA₁ x₁ y₁ * (x₂ - x₁) * Ring.inverse (W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁)

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeModulus_deuringCurve
statement:
theorem levelThreeModulus_deuringCurve {τ ν : F} (hν : ν ≠ 0) :
    (deuringCurve τ ν).levelThreeModulus 0 0 ν = τ

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeModulus_eq_div
statement:
theorem levelThreeModulus_eq_div (x₁ y₁ x₂ : F) : W.levelThreeModulus x₁ y₁ x₂ =
    (W.a₁ * W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁ + 2 * W.tangentSlopeNum x₁ y₁) * (x₂ - x₁) / W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁ ^ 2

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeModulus_map
statement:
theorem levelThreeModulus_map (x₁ y₁ x₂ : F) :
    (W.map φ).levelThreeModulus (φ x₁) (φ y₁) (φ x₂) = φ (W.levelThreeModulus x₁ y₁ x₂)

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeModulus_map_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem levelThreeModulus_map_of_isUnit {x₁ y₁ : R} (h : IsUnit (W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁)) (x₂ : R) :
    (W.map f).levelThreeModulus (f x₁) (f y₁) (f x₂) = f (W.levelThreeModulus x₁ y₁ x₂)

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeModulus_variableChange
statement:
theorem levelThreeModulus_variableChange (C : VariableChange F) (x₁ y₁ x₂ : F) :
    W.levelThreeModulus ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r) ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₂ + C.r)
      = (C • W).levelThreeModulus x₁ y₁ x₂

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeOrdinate_def
statement:
theorem levelThreeOrdinate_def (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : R) : W.levelThreeOrdinate x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ =
    (y₂ - y₁ - W.tangentSlope x₁ y₁ * (x₂ - x₁)) * (x₂ - x₁) ^ 3
      * Ring.inverse (W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁) ^ 3

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeOrdinate_deuringCurve
statement:
theorem levelThreeOrdinate_deuringCurve {τ ν : F} (hν : ν ≠ 0) (η : F) :
    (deuringCurve τ ν).levelThreeOrdinate 0 0 ν η = η

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeOrdinate_eq_div
statement:
theorem levelThreeOrdinate_eq_div (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : F) : W.levelThreeOrdinate x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ =
    (y₂ - y₁ - W.tangentSlope x₁ y₁ * (x₂ - x₁)) * (x₂ - x₁) ^ 3 / W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁ ^ 3

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeOrdinate_map
statement:
theorem levelThreeOrdinate_map (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : F) :
    (W.map φ).levelThreeOrdinate (φ x₁) (φ y₁) (φ x₂) (φ y₂) = φ (W.levelThreeOrdinate x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂)

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeOrdinate_map_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem levelThreeOrdinate_map_of_isUnit {x₁ y₁ : R} (h : IsUnit (W.deuringA₃ x₁ y₁)) (x₂ y₂ : R) :
    (W.map f).levelThreeOrdinate (f x₁) (f y₁) (f x₂) (f y₂) = f (W.levelThreeOrdinate x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂)

name: WeierstrassCurve.levelThreeOrdinate_variableChange
statement:
theorem levelThreeOrdinate_variableChange (C : VariableChange F) (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : F) :
    W.levelThreeOrdinate ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₁ + C.r) ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₁ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₁ + C.t)
        ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x₂ + C.r) ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y₂ + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x₂ + C.t)
      = (C • W).levelThreeOrdinate x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂

name: WeierstrassCurve.map_ringInverse_of_isUnit
statement: theorem map_ringInverse_of_isUnit {a : R} (h : IsUnit a) : f (Ring.inverse a) = Ring.inverse (f a)

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlopeNum_def
statement:
theorem tangentSlopeNum_def (x y : R) :
    W.tangentSlopeNum x y = 3 * x ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlopeNum_eq_neg_evalEval_polynomialX
statement:
theorem tangentSlopeNum_eq_neg_evalEval_polynomialX (x y : R) :
    W.tangentSlopeNum x y = -W.toAffine.polynomialX.evalEval x y

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlopeNum_map
statement:
theorem tangentSlopeNum_map (x y : R) :
    (W.map f).tangentSlopeNum (f x) (f y) = f (W.tangentSlopeNum x y)

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlopeNum_variableChange
statement:
theorem tangentSlopeNum_variableChange (C : VariableChange R) (x y : R) :
    W.tangentSlopeNum ((C.u : R) ^ 2 * x + C.r) ((C.u : R) ^ 3 * y + (C.u : R) ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t)
      = (C.u : R) ^ 4 * (C • W).tangentSlopeNum x y + C.s * (C.u : R) ^ 3 * (C • W).deuringA₃ x y

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlope_def
statement:
theorem tangentSlope_def (x y : R) :
    W.tangentSlope x y = W.tangentSlopeNum x y * Ring.inverse (W.deuringA₃ x y)

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlope_deuringCurve_zero
statement: theorem tangentSlope_deuringCurve_zero (τ ν : F) : (deuringCurve τ ν).tangentSlope 0 0 = 0

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlope_eq_div
statement:
theorem tangentSlope_eq_div (x y : F) :
    W.tangentSlope x y = W.tangentSlopeNum x y / W.deuringA₃ x y

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlope_eq_slope
statement:
theorem tangentSlope_eq_slope [DecidableEq F] {x y : F} (h : W.deuringA₃ x y ≠ 0) :
    W.tangentSlope x y = W.toAffine.slope x x y y

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlope_map
statement: theorem tangentSlope_map (x y : F) : (W.map φ).tangentSlope (φ x) (φ y) = φ (W.tangentSlope x y)

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlope_map_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem tangentSlope_map_of_isUnit {x y : R} (h : IsUnit (W.deuringA₃ x y)) :
    (W.map f).tangentSlope (f x) (f y) = f (W.tangentSlope x y)

name: WeierstrassCurve.tangentSlope_variableChange
statement:
theorem tangentSlope_variableChange (C : VariableChange F) {x y : F} (h : (C • W).deuringA₃ x y ≠ 0) :
    W.tangentSlope ((C.u : F) ^ 2 * x + C.r) ((C.u : F) ^ 3 * y + (C.u : F) ^ 2 * C.s * x + C.t)
      = (C.u : F) * (C • W).tangentSlope x y + C.s

name: WeierstrassCurve.pointAddEquivOfEq_refl

name: WeierstrassCurve.equation_zero_iff_of_isShortNF
statement:

name: WeierstrassCurve.velu2QuadDisc_of_isShortNF
statement:
lemma velu2QuadDisc_of_isShortNF (x : R) :
    W.velu2QuadDisc x = -16 * (3 * x ^ 2 + 4 * W.a₄)

name: WeierstrassCurve.veluGx_of_isShortNF
statement: lemma veluGx_of_isShortNF (x y : R) : W.veluGx x y = 3 * x ^ 2 + W.a₄

name: WeierstrassCurve.veluGy_zero_of_isShortNF
statement: lemma veluGy_zero_of_isShortNF (x : R) : W.veluGy x 0 = 0

name: WeierstrassCurve.veluQuotient2_eq_of_isShortNF
statement:
theorem veluQuotient2_eq_of_isShortNF (e : R) :

statement:
lemma variableChange_veluGx (x y : K) :
    (C • W).veluGx (Affine.vcXInv C x) (Affine.vcYInv C x y)
      = ((C.u⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) ^ 4 * (W.veluGx x y + C.s * W.veluGy x y)

name: WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_veluGy
statement:
lemma variableChange_veluGy (x y : K) :
    (C • W).veluGy (Affine.vcXInv C x) (Affine.vcYInv C x y)
      = ((C.u⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) ^ 3 * W.veluGy x y

name: WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_veluT
statement:
lemma variableChange_veluT (x y : K) :
    (C • W).veluT (Affine.vcXInv C x) (Affine.vcYInv C x y)
      = ((C.u⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) ^ 4 * W.veluT x y

name: WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_veluTSum
statement:
lemma variableChange_veluTSum :
    (C • W).veluTSum (S.map (vcInvEmbedding C))
      = ((C.u⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) ^ 4 * W.veluTSum S

name: WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_veluU
statement:
lemma variableChange_veluU (x y : K) :
    (C • W).veluU (Affine.vcXInv C x) (Affine.vcYInv C x y)
      = ((C.u⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) ^ 6 * W.veluU x y

name: WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_veluW
statement:
lemma variableChange_veluW (x y : K) :
    (C • W).veluW (Affine.vcXInv C x) (Affine.vcYInv C x y)
      = ((C.u⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) ^ 6 * (W.veluW x y - C.r * W.veluT x y)

name: WeierstrassCurve.variableChange_veluWSum
statement:
lemma variableChange_veluWSum :
    (C • W).veluWSum (S.map (vcInvEmbedding C))
      = ((C.u⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) ^ 6 * (W.veluWSum S - C.r * W.veluTSum S)

name: AutomorphicForm.heckeLFactorPoly_eq_iff
statement:
theorem heckeLFactorPoly_eq_iff {s e s' e' : R} :
    heckeLFactorPoly s e = heckeLFactorPoly s' e' ↔ s = s' ∧ e = e'

name: AutomorphicForm.heckeLFactorPoly_inj

theorem heckeLFactorPoly_inj {s e s' e' : R}

name: AutomorphicForm.heckeLFactorPoly_satakePow_one
statement:
theorem heckeLFactorPoly_satakePow_one (s e : R) :

name: AutomorphicForm.heckeLFactorPoly_satakePow_split
statement:
theorem heckeLFactorPoly_satakePow_split (f : ℕ) (α β : R) :
    heckeLFactorPoly (satakePow f (α + β) (α * β)) ((α * β) ^ f)
      = (1 - C (α ^ f) * X) * (1 - C (β ^ f) * X)

name: AutomorphicForm.heckeLFactorPoly_satakePow_two
statement:
theorem heckeLFactorPoly_satakePow_two (s e : R) :
    heckeLFactorPoly (satakePow 2 s e) (e ^ 2)
      = 1 - C (s ^ 2 - 2 * e) * X + C (e ^ 2) * X ^ 2

name: AutomorphicForm.heckeLFactorPoly_split
statement:
theorem heckeLFactorPoly_split (α β : R) :
    heckeLFactorPoly (α + β) (α * β) = (1 - C α * X) * (1 - C β * X)

name: AutomorphicForm.map_heckeLFactorPoly

theorem map_heckeLFactorPoly {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (s e : R) :

name: AutomorphicForm.satakePow_two
statement:

    ∃ x : WithConv (S →ₐ[GaloisRep.inertiaRing A] GaloisRep.inertiaRing A),
      toQbarPt A x = ψ ∧
      (∀ s, algebraMap (GaloisRep.inertiaRing A) ℚ̄ (x s) = ψ s) ∧

      ((∀ s, A.valuation (ψ s - algebraMap (GaloisRep.inertiaRing A) ℚ̄ (Coalgebra.counit (R := GaloisRep.inertiaRing A) s)) < 1) →

    {J J' : Type} [AddCommGroup J] [AddCommGroup J'] {L : Type} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (A : Set J) (X' : Set J') (hA : A.Finite) (hX' : X'.Finite)
    (hA0 : (0 : J) ∈ A) (hAadd : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, x + y ∈ A) (hAneg : ∀ x ∈ A, -x ∈ A)
    (hX'0 : (0 : J') ∈ X') (hX'add : ∀ x ∈ X', ∀ y ∈ X', x + y ∈ X') (hX'neg : ∀ x ∈ X', -x ∈ X')
    (B : J → J' → L)

    Set.ncard {y : J' | y ∈ X' ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, B a y = 1} * Set.ncard A =

    ∃ e : AffineDilatation.Ring
          (Ideal.span (insert (MvPolynomial.C π) (Set.range fun j : τ => (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr j) : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R))))

name: Algebra.exists_ne_zero_algebraicIndependent_forall_isIntegral_pow_smul_of_finiteType
statement:
theorem Algebra.exists_ne_zero_algebraicIndependent_forall_isIntegral_pow_smul_of_finiteType
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    [Algebra R C] [FaithfulSMul R C] [Algebra.FiniteType R C] :
    ∃ r : R, r ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ (d : ℕ) (z : Fin d → C), AlgebraicIndependent R z ∧
      ∀ c : C, ∃ n : ℕ, IsIntegral (Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range z)) (r ^ n • c)
